articles.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol get to the point faster but score lower on transparency than Claude
articles.descEn: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give much shorter, more direct answers than their predecessors, but they are also less willing to admit uncertainty. Anthropic's Claude models score well ahead on transparency.
articles.titleEn: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol get to the point faster but score lower on transparency than Claude
summaryLinesEn: An evaluation by Artificial Analysis shows that OpenAI's new GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models produce answers 34 to 40 percent shorter than their predecessors, answer questions more directly, and use far fewer headings and em dashes.
A score of 24 doesn't mean Astra only admits uncertainty in 24 percent of its answers.
Astra's score on that trait dropped from 96 to 24, while Sol's fell from 98 to 51.

A score of 24 doesn't mean Astra only admits uncertainty in 24 percent of its answers.
Astra's score on that trait dropped from 96 to 24, while Sol's fell from 98 to 51.

articles.title: Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent
articles.descEn: Major US financial institutions are banning third-party bots from logging into your accounts—and warning that any costly bot mistakes are strictly your problem.
articles.titleEn: Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent
summaryLinesEn: While Kim expects some consumers to feel like it's unfair to be held accountable for their agent’s mistakes, she doesn’t expect these policy moves by financial institutions to scare off the early-adopter crowd already in deep and using the tools as part of everyday life.
Citigroup even launched an internal development platform specifically centered on agents.
“Your use of any AI Agent is AT YOUR OWN RISK,” read Wells Fargo’s new terms .

articles.title: AI is getting better faster than experts can reliably test whether new systems are safe, METR warns
articles.descEn: METR reports that leading AI models like Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra are improving rapidly at research tasks but getting harder to measure. Current data can't rule out a dangerous acceleration in AI development, the organization warns, though it also says common tests may overestimate what the models can actually do.
articles.titleEn: AI is getting better faster than experts can reliably test whether new systems are safe, METR warns
summaryLinesEn: A naive extrapolation of METR's data puts them at a 50 percent success rate on the longest, 200-hour tasks by July 2027.
The systems still struggle with open-ended questions that lack immediate feedback and require real judgment, as well as with situations that are hard to recreate for training, according to METR.
For tasks that take humans longer, the task length the models can handle doubles every 3.6 months.

sourceContent.headline: AI is getting better faster than experts can reliably test whether new systems are safe, METR warns
sourceContent.description: METR reports that leading AI models like Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra are improving rapidly at research tasks but getting harder to measure. Current data can't rule out a dangerous acceleration in AI development, the organization warns, though it also says common tests may overestimate what the models can actually do.
paragraphs: A naive extrapolation of METR's data puts them at a 50 percent success rate on the longest, 200-hour tasks by July 2027.
The systems still struggle with open-ended questions that lack immediate feedback and require real judgment, as well as with situations that are hard to recreate for training, according to METR.
For tasks that take humans longer, the task length the models can handle doubles every 3.6 months.

AI models are rapidly improving at AI research tasks, and they're getting harder to measure. According to the AI research organization METR , current public data isn't enough to rule out a drastic acceleration in AI research over the next few years. That could leave humans unable "to meaningfully understand, assess, and react to catastrophic risks posed by new AI systems," the organization warns.

On clearly defined coding and computational tasks with direct feedback, the models already beat experienced human professionals most of the time, METR found, though they haven't yet outperformed large groups of top experts. For tasks that take humans longer, the task length the models can handle doubles every 3.6 months. A naive extrapolation of METR's data puts them at a 50 percent success rate on the longest, 200-hour tasks by July 2027.

The systems still struggle with open-ended questions that lack immediate feedback and require real judgment, as well as with situations that are hard to recreate for training, according to METR. The organization also warns that common, easy-to-run tests may overestimate how well the models perform in real-world use, since developers train them in very similar test environments. Ad Ad

articles.title: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
articles.descEn: A new real-world test puts AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs, where they have to keep developing software on their own and reliably close open tickets in a messy daily workflow. Even Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short, solving fewer than one in ten tasks completely. The models finish clear, standalone assignments quickly, but they lose track as autonomous developers.
articles.titleEn: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
summaryLinesEn: Success stories about AI coding agents keep piling up.
Even Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra fully complete fewer than one in ten tasks.
Anthropic says Claude writes more than 80 percent of the company's production code , and standard benchmarks like SWE-bench are nearly saturated.

articles.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
articles.descEn: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
summaryLinesEn: GPT-4 launched in March 2023 with 8,192 tokens.
An Nvidia research team says that's often overkill and expensive.
Today, GPT 5.6 Sol handles around one million tokens, about 120 times as much and enough for Tolstoy's "War and Peace."

articles.title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
articles.descEn: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup — in a trend that's already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes a trend in Hollywood, too.
articles.titleEn: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
summaryLinesEn: A recent report in Rest of World found that Microdrama firms were paying people “between US$15 to US$700 to license their facial likenesses.”
“One of the things that AI does is it enables smaller teams to be able to produce these movie-scale productions,” Shimoni said.
The project, which is wholly AI, used Avni’s face to create a digital avatar of him.

articles.title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
articles.descEn: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up.
articles.titleEn: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
summaryLinesEn: David Hilbert placed it on his 1900 list of math's most important problems, and since 2000 it has carried a $1 million prize as one of the Clay Mathematics Institute's seven "Millennium Problems."
Once they moved to the actual problem, the AI took over and left him far behind near the finish line.

Printed out, Claude's argument would run over 250,000 pages, Alpöge says, because the AI spells out even basic rules, such as a number other than one-half being either larger or smaller than one-half.

articles.title: Etsy says it will not use sellers' content to train AI after they revolt over policy changes - Engadget
articles.descEn: Etsy changed its terms of use, adding a clause on AI training. Now, it has clarified that it will not use sellers’ content to train AI that can copy their work.
articles.titleEn: Etsy says it will not use sellers' content to train AI after they revolt over policy changes - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: He said that Etsy uses sellers' content to enable automatic translations of their listing descriptions and to feature their listings in marketing campaigns.
Etsy sellers have been abandoning the platform after it updated its Terms of Use with language indicating that it can use their content to train AI.

To be exact, the new addition to its terms states that Etsy and its "third party partners and vendors" will have the right to use sellers content to "develop, train, test and improve artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies."

articles.title: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
articles.descEn: A Buddhist monastery in Vermont called Maple wants to establish itself as Silicon Valley's spiritual authority while creating its own AI god. According to a New Yorker report, leader Soryu Forall's group records every breath its members take to train an AI in his image. Former members report manipulation and psychological breakdowns.
articles.titleEn: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
summaryLinesEn: In AI Impacts' 2024 survey of more than 1,500 AI researchers, respondents put the chance of AI causing human extinction or a similarly permanent, severe disempowerment of humanity at 18 percent on average .

A report links these events to growing doomsday beliefs in tech, where intense psychological pressure and extinction fears push researchers toward religious thinking and cultish devotion to language models.
Tax filings show the organization brings in up to $1 million a year.

summaryLines: 1,500명 이상의 AI 연구자를 대상으로 한 AI Impacts의 2024년 설문조사에서 응답자들은 AI가 인류를 멸종시키거나 이와 유사하게 영구적이고 심각한 인류의 무력화를 초래할 가능성을 평균 18%로 꼽았음
한 보고서는 이러한 사건을 기술에 대한 종말론적 믿음이 커지는 것과 관련이 있으며, 극심한 심리적 압박과 멸종에 대한 두려움으로 인해 연구자들은 언어 모델에 대한 종교적인 사고와 문화적 헌신을 하게 됨
세금 신고서에 따르면 해당 조직은 연간 최대 100만 달러를 수입함

summaryLinesEn: Positron AI Inc., which raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation in September, builds inference appliances around commodity memory instead of scarce high-bandwidth memory.

articles.title: Sovereign AI factory in Germany wins startups with no lock-in - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: A sovereign AI factory in Stuttgart aims to win startups and small firms with human support and no lock-in, HammerHAI's Bastian Koller says.
articles.titleEn: Sovereign AI factory in Germany wins startups with no lock-in - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: “We cannot now say, okay, come back in 10 years when we have a sovereign processor or a sovereign GPU or something like this,” Koller said.
“It’s very important to bring them there because everybody’s talking about AI, but we focus especially on SMEs and startups,” Koller said.
“… We can build up a system which is highly fancy, whatever there, nobody will use it because we never thought about what the user needs.”

articles.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Self-hosting LLMs on GPUs means paying to recompute the same context on every turn. Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut inference cost by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%. This post walks through the distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS, which evaluates and sets up the cache from your coding agent.
articles.titleEn: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut self-hosted LLM inference costs by up to 40% and time to first token (TTFT) by up to 80%.
The agent estimates savings from your own traffic with KVTrace, at no additional charge, and stops if they don’t cover the cache’s cost.
With this skill, you can evaluate and set up distributed KV caching from within your coding agent in a few prompts.

articles.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
articles.descEn: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.
articles.titleEn: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
summaryLinesEn: Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.

Signal announced Friday that it’s limiting users’ ability to take screenshots within the secure messaging app — a response to what President Meredith Whittaker described as the “existential threat” of operating systems that integrate agentic AI.
Signal already sought to limit these risks by blocking screenshots of its Windows app by default.

articles.title: One gigabyte of Wikipedia losslessly compressed to 105.39MB with self-learning AI transformer model — 'tufazip' needs two Nvidia B200 GPUs and about a week to compress or decompress
articles.descEn: A dozen hybrid compressors can beat its score, but none relies on a neural network alone.
articles.titleEn: One gigabyte of Wikipedia losslessly compressed to 105.39MB with self-learning AI transformer model — 'tufazip' needs two Nvidia B200 GPUs and about a week to compress or decompress
summaryLinesEn: Its GPUs peaked at 43.37 GiB of VRAM between them, and total memory use, GPUs included, peaked at roughly 68,525 MiB during compression and 73,748 MiB during decompression.

Alibaba claims new Qwen Image 2.1 AI model beats Google Nano Banana 2.0 with minuscule 7B parameter model Homelabber’s second-gen Optane build uses two RTX 3090s to run 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi AI model at 3.11 tokens per second Lawyer builds private AI server with eight used Nvidia V100 GPUs While this sounds more exciting than, say, WinRAR, it’s for research purposes and not a product, and that’s underlined by what you’d need to actually run it.

Currently, two Nvidia B200 GPUs — plus two Intel Xeon Platinum 8570 CPUs in the test machine — would need 631,548 seconds to compress and 645,748 seconds to decompress the 105.39MB version, or about 7.3 and 7.5 days, respectively, not counting the starter’s offline training.

localization.title: 자가 학습 AI 변환기 모델을 사용하여 105.39MB로 무손실 압축된 1GB의 Wikipedia - 'tufazip'에는 Nvidia B200 GPU 2개가 필요하며 압축하거나 압축을 푸는 데 약 일주일이 소요됨
summaryLines: GPU는 둘 사이에서 최고 43.37GiB의 VRAM을 기록했고, GPU를 포함한 총 메모리 사용량은 압축 중 약 68,525MiB, 압축 해제 중 73,748MiB로 최고치를 기록함

Alibaba는 새로운 Qwen Image 2.1 AI 모델이 아주 작은 7B 매개변수 모델로 Google Nano Banana 2.0을 능가한다고 주장함 · Homelabber의 2세대 Optane 빌드는 2개의 RTX 3090을 사용하여 초당 3.11개의 토큰으로 2.8조 매개변수 Kimi AI 모델을 실행함 · Lawyer는 8개의 Nvidia V100 GPU를 사용하여 개인 AI 서버를 구축함 · 이는 WinRAR보다 더 흥미롭지만 연구 목적임 · 제품이 아니라 실제로 실행하는 데 필요한 것이 강조되어 있음

summaryLines: Simply Wall St · • 3일 전 SMCI AMD Supermicro 주식은 실적이 상회하고 2027년 판매 전망이 더 높아진 후 초점을 맞췄습니다 Simply Wall St · • 16일 전 SMCI Super Micro Computer(SMCI) 주식이 하락했는데 지금 주목을 끌고 있는 것은 무엇입니까
Super Micro Computer는 2027 회계연도 수익 전망을 상향 조정하고 AI 관련 솔루션이 매출의 약 70~80%를 차지할 것으로 예상하며 AI 데이터 센터 구축을 지원하기 위해 새로운 AMD EPYC 기반 올플래시 스토리지와 H15 서버를 출시하고 있음
RogueEP의 자체 설명에서는 0.0%의 연간 수익 성장 가정과 11.0%의 미래 이익 마진을 사용하여 Super Micro Computer의 공정 가치를 미화 55.85달러에 도달했으며, 이 주식을 공격적인 AI 성장 스토리가 아닌 성숙하고 꾸준한 수익자로 취급함

articles.title: Scale AI cofounder says she passed on an Anthropic investment to support her ex: 'Lost a billion'
articles.descEn: Investor Sarah Guo said she passed on an early Anthropic investment to support her ex-girlfriend. "Love makes you dumb," she said. "Stay single."
articles.titleEn: Scale AI cofounder says she passed on an Anthropic investment to support her ex: 'Lost a billion'
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic's Series F, which valued it at the $183 billion Guo referenced, was announced in September 2025.
"If you ever feel stupid, just know that I didn't invest in Anthropic at $183B because I wanted to continue supporting my ex's lifestyle," Guo wrote on X.
We do crazy things for love — in Lucy Guo's case, she says that includes passing on an Anthropic investment that could've netted a billion dollars.

articles.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis — and a human did, too
articles.descEn: Mathematicians are having their minds blown by the latest AI-driven result — and there's a competing human solution, too.
articles.titleEn: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis — and a human did, too
summaryLinesEn: In a brief introduction to his proof, which he said is the result of 12 years of work, Masullo wrote that “if any message at all this work is meant to send to the mathematician who feels discouraged by the pace and tone of the current climate, it is this: we are still here.
For my part, I tapped out of mathematics at college calculus, so I can’t help decode exactly what that means.

“The precise timing is horrible,” he wrote in an essay announcing his findings and describing how he messaged Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei last Sunday night to ask how to announce that he had found a Lean-compilable solution to the Riemann Hypothesis, which dates back to 1859 and is among the Millennium Prize math problems.

localization.title: AI는 167년 된 리만 가설에 대한 해결책을 주장했고, 인간도 그렇게 함
summaryLines: Masullo는 12년간의 작업 결과라고 말한 자신의 증명에 대한 간략한 소개에서 "이 작업이 현재 기후의 속도와 분위기에 낙담한 수학자에게 보내는 메시지라면 그것은 이것임 · 우리는 여전히 여기에 있다"고 썼음
저는 대학 미적분학에서 수학을 배웠기 때문에 그것이 무엇을 의미하는지 정확히 해석할 수는 없음
그는 자신의 연구 결과를 발표하고 지난 일요일 밤 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei에게 메시지를 보내 1859년으로 거슬러 올라가 밀레니엄 상 수학 문제 중 하나인 리만 가설에 대한 린 컴파일 가능한 해결책을 찾았음을 알리는 방법을 묻는 방법을 설명하는 에세이에서 "정확한 타이밍이 끔찍합니다"라고 썼음

articles.title: Signal now blocks screenshots by default to stymie AI agents - Engadget
articles.descEn: It describes the fix as incomplete and calls for a simple way for developers to opt out of AI snooping.
articles.titleEn: Signal now blocks screenshots by default to stymie AI agents - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: But the byproduct is that chats meant to be private — including encrypted ones — can end up on a remote server outside your or Signal's control.
The assistants are designed to help users by reading what's on the screen and pulling in information to better answer their questions.
The encrypted messaging app said Friday that it will block screenshots by default on iOS 27, and on Android when AI assistants try to capture the screen.

summaryLinesEn: The one thing I can't get over is the fact that it looks like two vapes put together.
Between a pair of Nothing Headphone 1 Pro headphones and a MacBook Pro, we can see a device that clearly fits the description of a screenless gadget like the one described by Nothing.
We'll reserve judgment until we see the new device in person, but right now it looks like a rare miss by Nothing's design team.

articles.title: Anthropic goes public, but is it too late to save the AI trade? - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Anthropic goes public, but is it too late to save the AI trade? - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Anthropic goes public, but is it too late to save the AI trade? - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: No doubt Anthropic stock will be at least as volatile as other AI stocks, but it can live with that alongside the more than $90 billion in its bank account.

Nvidia posted its usual better-than-expected earnings this week, which didn’t help its stock much but indicates, along with interim CEO Colette Kress’ bullish comments during the earnings call, that it’s going to be fine in disgraced former CEO Jensen Huang’s absence.
Palo Alto Networks remains one of the most acquisitive cybersecurity companies out there, once again laying out a tidy sum this week, buying AI startup Applied Compute this week $4.5 billion.

summaryLines: 의심할 여지 없이 인류 주식은 적어도 다른 AI 주식만큼 변동성이 크겠지만, 은행 계좌에 900억 달러가 넘는 금액과 함께 그 변동성을 감당할 수 있음
엔비디아는 이번 주 예상보다 나은 실적을 발표했는데, 이는 주가에 큰 도움이 되지는 않았지만 임시 CEO 콜레트 크레스(Colette Kress)의 낙관적인 발언과 함께 불명예스러운 전 CEO 젠슨 황(Jensen Huang)의 부재에도 괜찮을 것이라는 점을 나타냄
Palo Alto Networks는 가장 인수적인 사이버 보안 회사 중 하나로 남아 있으며 이번 주에 AI 스타트업 Applied Compute를 45억 달러에 인수하여 이번 주에 다시 한번 깔끔한 금액을 제시함

articles.title: Model plane shifts on-prem as agentic AI favors owning compute - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: The model plane is moving on-prem as agentic AI grows, and Oxide Computer Co. CTO Bryan Cantrill says enterprises want to own their compute.
articles.titleEn: Model plane shifts on-prem as agentic AI favors owning compute - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Oxide Computer Co., which raised $445 million in October to expand rack production, built its business on the idea that enterprises at scale will want to own their computers, according to Bryan Cantrill (pictured), co-founder and chief technology officer at Oxide.
That shift favors companies that built early for on-premises cloud infrastructure.
“You want all that flexibility that you get from elastic compute, but you need it for economic reasons, security reasons, latency reasons,” Cantrill said of the case for on-premises cloud computing.

summaryLines: Oxide의 공동 창립자이자 최고 기술 책임자인 Bryan Cantrill(사진)에 따르면 랙 생산을 확대하기 위해 10월에 4억 4,500만 달러를 모금한 Oxide Computer Co.는 대규모 기업이 컴퓨터를 소유하기를 원할 것이라는 생각을 바탕으로 사업을 구축함
이러한 변화는 초기에 온프레미스 클라우드 인프라를 구축한 회사에 유리함
Cantrill은 온프레미스 클라우드 컴퓨팅 사례에 대해 “탄력적인 컴퓨팅에서 얻을 수 있는 모든 유연성을 원하지만 경제적인 이유, 보안상의 이유, 지연 시간의 이유로 필요함” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Apple joins the race for AI agents that control your device while raising new barriers for competitors
articles.descEn: After Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google launched their own AI agents, Apple is now building one too - while making it harder for rivals to access its devices.
articles.titleEn: Apple joins the race for AI agents that control your device while raising new barriers for competitors
summaryLinesEn: According to a job listing , Apple is hiring a senior engineer to lead the project as a rival to Muse, Dots, Duet, and Grok Bots.
After Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google launched their own AI agents, Apple is now building one too - while making it harder for rivals to access its devices.
Meanwhile, macOS 27.3 now requires 14 steps instead of four for users to let third-party agents like ChatGPT control their Macs.

articles.title: Bloomberg analysis of 10 million job postings shows AI-exposed roles in China fell 10 percentage points faster than others
articles.descEn: A Bloomberg News analysis of 10 million job postings suggests AI is compounding China's already weak labor market. Entry-level workers and the creative industry are feeling the shift most, with more than 90% of Chinese micro-dramas now produced using AI. Former central bank adviser Cai Fang warns that a larger AI shock is still ahead.
articles.titleEn: Bloomberg analysis of 10 million job postings shows AI-exposed roles in China fell 10 percentage points faster than others
summaryLinesEn: According to a Bloomberg News analysis of nearly 10 million online job postings between July 2021 and June 2025, listings for jobs highly exposed to AI fell about 10 percentage points more than listings for less affected roles.

Bloomberg found that the total number of online job postings halved in the three years after June 2022, a starting point shortly before OpenAI launched ChatGPT and Chinese models like DeepSeek and ByteDance's Doubao rose to prominence.
An analysis of 10 million job postings by Bloomberg suggests that AI is putting additional pressure on China's already weak labor market.

articles.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
articles.descEn: Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users’ messages and other data.

summaryLinesEn: I let Apple’s always-listening AI summarize my life for two weeks Microsoft is killing its great tasks app in favor of its worse tasks app Grand Theft Auto VI does something impossible — it lives up to the hype

Users can restore screenshot capabilities in Signal’s app settings, but Whittaker warns that doing so will “potentially expose your (and your contacts’) Signal content to these AI agents, and break our privacy guarantees.”

summaryLines: Apple의 상시 청취 AI가 2주 동안 내 인생을 요약하도록 함 · Microsoft는 더 나쁜 작업을 위해 훌륭한 작업 앱을 종료하고 있음 · Grand Theft Auto VI 앱은 불가능한 일을 수행함 · 과대 광고에 부응함
사용자는 Signal의 앱 설정에서 스크린샷 기능을 복원할 수 있지만 Whittaker는 그렇게 하면 "잠재적으로 귀하(및 귀하의 연락처)의 Signal 콘텐츠가 이러한 AI 에이전트에 노출되고 개인 정보 보호 보장이 침해될 수 있다"고 경고함
Whittaker는 “이러한 상식적인 해결책 없이 현재 AI 에이전트를 운영 체제에 통합하는 것은 애플리케이션 계층의 개인 정보 보호에 대한 실존적 위협과 Signal과 같은 독립 개발자의 능력을 나타냄을 인식해야 함” · 라고 Whittaker는 말함

articles.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
articles.descEn: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely…
articles.titleEn: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
summaryLinesEn: In general, METR is clearly butting up against the practical difficulties of testing AI performance on difficult and underspecified tasks—precisely the ones most relevant to automating AI R&D.

In the new report, however, the completion times are mostly estimates, because paying people for tasks that might take hundreds of hours, or that only a few experts are qualified to complete, is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming.
The updated plot adds more tasks—some that are estimated to take humans far longer than those in the original suite, and others that are more open-ended.

summaryLinesEn: Researchers planted 2 million digital tripwires in requests sent through a sprawling network of AI services to find out what happened to sensitive information entrusted to them.

In the event any of the secrets were leaked, these “canaries”—so called because they resemble the role of that bird when taken into coal mines—would allow Moore to identify each link in the chain that was responsible.
The scraper typically showed up two or three days after the request.

articles.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
articles.descEn: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of the Millennium Prize problems in math.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
summaryLinesEn: Alpöge’s solution, presented in Lean, has only been published on his website and has not yet been publicly accepted by the Clay Mathematics Institute, which administers the Millennium Prize and offers a $1 million bounty for each problem solved.

Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics’s most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world’s best mathematicians for decades.
Anthropic said it was working on the Riemann Hypothesis with Claude in August , but noted at the time: “We don’t expect that the techniques Claude used will lead to proving the Riemann hypothesis.”

localization.title: 인류 수학자들은 클로드와 함께 권위 있는 밀레니엄 상 문제를 해결했다고 주장함
summaryLines: Lean으로 제시된 Alpöge의 솔루션은 그의 웹사이트에만 게시되었으며 밀레니엄 상을 관리하고 해결된 각 문제에 대해 100만 달러의 현상금을 제공하는 Clay Mathematics Institute에서 아직 공개적으로 승인되지 않음
인류 수학자 레벤트 알포게(Levent Alpöge)는 클로드의 도움으로 수학에서 가장 악명 높은 어려운 문제 중 하나인 리만 가설을 증명했으며, 수십 년 동안 세계 최고의 수학자들이 풀지 못했던 퍼즐을 풀었다고 주장함
Anthropic은 지난 8월 Claude와 함께 Riemann 가설을 연구 중이라고 밝혔지만 당시에는 "Claude가 사용한 기술이 Riemann 가설을 증명할 것으로 기대하지 않음" · 라고 언급함

articles.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
articles.descEn: President Donald Trump threatened to tax companies that build data centers outside of the US, warning about the country falling behind in AI.
articles.titleEn: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
summaryLinesEn: Trump didn’t share many details behind the plan, and apparently was floating the proposal publicly for the first time.

“We’re not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country,” Trump said at a press conference Friday following his summit with China President Xi Jinping and Russia President Vladimir Putin.

President Donald Trump promised to put a “tremendous tax” on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them.

articles.titleEn: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
summaryLinesEn: Compound 23 blocked PRMT5 in cells at a lower concentration, while compound 24 crossed the cell barrier more readily and broke down more slowly in the liver-enzyme assay.
While the benchmark evaluates reasoning from historical evidence rather than real-world drug discovery, its results help identify where models are advancing and where challenges remain.
A compound might act strongly against a disease related protein but be poorly absorbed or break down too quickly in the body.

articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
summaryLinesEn: And most of all, share a fully reusable recipe, so you can reproduce this on your own task, harness, model combinations.

If we freeze those weights and add a custom RL-trained LoRA adapter we can get 55% pass@1, with average token usage of 1.5K.

articles.title: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0
articles.descEn: Today we're releasing version 1.0 of Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy). It's on for everyone who uses Muse, Meta's AI agent, enabled for every merchant on Shopify, and live with multiple design partners.
articles.titleEn: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0
summaryLinesEn: Mercury puts personal agents to work on finances: People who use Mercury for business and personal banking can now ask their personal agent to check balances, review recent transactions, categorize spending, or keep budgets and receipts up to date.

Made it easier for companies to adopt the protocol in stages, starting with the basics and adding capabilities over time; Expanded a company’s ability to provide guidance and collect feedback from the personal agent; Introduced extensions, such as the commerce extension co-authored by Shopify, so industries can build on the core protocol without changing it.
Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default.

localization.title: 개인 에이전트 프로토콜 1.0 출시
summaryLines: Mercury는 개인 에이전트를 통해 재무 업무를 수행함 · 비즈니스 및 개인 금융 업무에 Mercury를 사용하는 사람들은 이제 개인 에이전트에게 잔액 확인, 최근 거래 검토, 지출 분류, 예산 및 영수증 최신 상태 유지 등을 요청할 수 있음
기업이 기본부터 시작하여 시간이 지남에 따라 기능을 추가하는 단계적으로 프로토콜을 채택하기가 더 쉬워졌음 · 개인 에이전트로부터 지침을 제공하고 피드백을 수집하는 회사의 능력을 확대함 · Shopify가 공동으로 작성한 상거래 확장과 같은 확장 기능을 도입하여 업계에서는 핵심 프로토콜을 변경하지 않고도 핵심 프로토콜을 기반으로 구축할 수 있음
Sierra와 Shopify는 수백만 명의 판매자에게 Poppy를 제공함 · Shopify는 175개 이상의 국가에서 비즈니스를 지원하며 모든 Shopify 매장은 기본적으로 UCP(Universal Commerce Protocol)를 지원함

articles.title: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Kimi Code CLI v2.7.0 adds a native Amazon Bedrock provider, so you can connect the open source coding agent to models like Kimi K3.1 Pro using your standard AWS credential chain (named profiles or SSO) instead of a separate API key. This post shows how to configure the provider and send your first request.
articles.titleEn: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Replace ${AWS_REGION} with your source Region (for example, us-west-2 for US West Oregon) and ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID} with your 12-digit AWS account ID: The foundation-model ARN without a Region or account ID is intentional and required for global cross-Region routing.
You don’t need to place any AWS access key or manually generated Amazon Bedrock key in the Kimi Code config.toml .
If you set KIMI_CODE_HOME , use $KIMI_CODE_HOME/config.toml instead.

articles.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: This second installment reviews 13 more Amazon SageMaker AI inference launches from 2026, spanning configuration recommendations, fitting more models onto each GPU, serving models too large for one instance, cross-Region routing, and post-launch tuning, bringing the year's total to 26.
articles.titleEn: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2 | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Teams want to know which configuration the model should run on now that traffic is real, how to fit more models onto GPUs they already pay for, what to do when the next model is too large for one machine, why requests wait in one Region while GPUs sit idle in another, and why latency rose when nobody changed anything.
Inference recommendations launched in April as an API.
In the spring, they launched a customer support assistant on a 70B-parameter model behind a single SageMaker AI endpoint, using the launches from part 1.

articles.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
articles.descEn: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
summaryLinesEn: Aggregate gross proceeds from the initial public offering, including the shares sold by the selling stockholders, and the concurrent private placement were approximately $119.5 billion, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses.
The offering was made only by means of a prospectus.
The offering consisted of 1,103,351,354 shares sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares sold by certain selling stockholders.

summaryLinesEn: GTA VI heads into launch with 24.5 million pre-orders, generating $2.36 billion in revenue across PlayStation and Xbox.

Our latest report, The Attention Heist: GTA VI's Impact on Consumer Engagement , looks at which games are most exposed to the launch, how long GTA VI could hold players' attention, and where that time might go across other apps and platforms.

articles.title: What every Medical Affairs leader needs to know about generative AI in pharma
articles.descEn: Learn how Medical Affairs leaders use generative AI to boost productivity, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation in the pharmaceutical industry.
articles.titleEn: What every Medical Affairs leader needs to know about generative AI in pharma
summaryLinesEn: The insights they share will provide the answers you’re seeking and inspire you to implement AI within your organization: Rob Stevens , 20-year veteran in the pharma industry, including former Global Head, Digital Medical Affairs at Novartis Zayed Yasin , MD, healthcare industry lead at WRITER and practicing ER physician The main challenge with generative AI in pharma is figuring out how to strike the right balance.
Delivering information when it’s most needed amplifies its impact — which is exactly where generative AI can make up for lost time.

articles.title: How Watch Duty is using Gemini to get wildfire alerts out faster
articles.descEn: Watch Duty uses Google Gemini to transcribe fire radio into text, detecting wildfire dispatches in under 30 seconds. See how the tool saves lives.
articles.titleEn: How Watch Duty is using Gemini to get wildfire alerts out faster
summaryLinesEn: As a result of the collaboration between Google and Watch Duty, volunteer reporter satisfaction with radio transcription tools increased from 35.3% to 92.3%.
Funding : In 2024, Google.org provided Watch Duty with $2 million in funding and $300,000 in Google Cloud credits to help compile satellite, camera, and radio data to validate new fires.
As its audience grew to more than 16 million people last year, Google Cloud raised its messaging limit from 600,000 to 1 million to help alerts arrive without delay.

articles.title: How personal agents will change customer experience
articles.descEn: Personal agents are becoming a new way for customers to interact with businesses. Here’s what that shift means for customer experience, trust, and brand control.
articles.titleEn: How personal agents will change customer experience
summaryLinesEn: Learn why your own agent is your digital front door, and how to serve customers directly through the personal agents acting for them Meta reported that more than 10 million people in the US and Canada set up Muse in its first six weeks.

localization.title: 개인 에이전트가 고객 경험을 어떻게 변화시킬 것인가
summaryLines: 자신의 에이전트가 디지털 정문인 이유와 고객을 대신하는 개인 에이전트를 통해 고객에게 직접 서비스를 제공하는 방법을 알아보세요 · Meta는 처음 6주 만에 미국과 캐나다에서 천만 명 이상의 사람들이 Muse를 설정했다고 보고함
새로운 백서인 개인 에이전트와 기업에서는 개인 에이전트가 어떻게 수요와 경쟁을 변화시킬 수 있는지, 기업이 에이전트를 통해 고객에게 직접 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 방법, 더 깊은 참여를 지속적인 가치로 전환하는 방법을 살펴봄
개인 에이전트가 소비자의 손에 들어온 지 불과 몇 달밖에 되지 않았으며 채택률이 빠르게 증가하고 있음

summaryLinesEn: Sierra is heading into year three with over $150M in ARR, powered by rapid adoption from some of the world’s largest companies.
The growth reflects a simple idea: when AI is built around real jobs to be done (not experiments), even the biggest enterprises can see meaningful impact fast.
One theme runs through all of their answers: by the time someone sits down to look at a problem, Ghostwriter has usually found it, understood the cause, or drafted a change to fix it.

articles.title: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Announcing the general availability of Amazon Textract Insights, a new generative AI feature of Amazon Textract. Describe the fields you need in natural language, submit a document or a mixed packet, and receive structured results with a confidence score and page-level grounding for each value, with no model training required.
articles.titleEn: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Amazon Textract Insights encrypts projects and blueprints at rest with AWS owned keys.
You create an Amazon Textract Insights project with the AWS public W-2, payslip, and bank statement blueprints, add a custom blueprint for loan officer notes, and enable splitting.
You then submit a single file of up to 3,000 pages from your own Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket and enable splitting.

articles.title: How Standard Bank Group automates AI risk assessment for generative AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Standard Bank Group automated the evidence behind its generative AI approval gates. Working with AWS Professional Services, the bank built an assessment in its own AWS account that scores each use case against international AI standards and its own policies using LLM-as-a-judge on Amazon Bedrock, giving risk committees consistent, traceable evidence.

summaryLinesEn: Standard Bank Group also customized the lens with judge questions built from its own standards, bringing the total to more than 300.

articles.title: Introducing Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway: One endpoint across Regions and clusters | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod introduces the Global Inference Gateway, one managed endpoint that routes inference requests across your HyperPod clusters in one Region or across Regions. It picks the best cluster, fails over automatically, and authenticates every request with SigV4 and IAM over AWS PrivateLink.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway: One endpoint across Regions and clusters | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The challenge: Capacity spread across clusters and Regions Models are getting larger, and the GPU capacity to serve them is harder to find.
The Global Inference Gateway helps you get more from the GPU capacity you already have, with less to operate.
Setting up the gateway takes two decisions: which clusters to open up for routing, and which of them to group behind one gateway.

articles.title: Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers managed cluster extensions for observability and user management, bringing declarative, API- and console-driven configuration to the software running on Slurm cluster nodes. This post explains how the extensions work and follows a platform team through a quarter of running a shared Slurm cluster with them.
articles.titleEn: Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Continuous provisioning for Slurm retries capacity requests in the background; AMI-based configuration works with it , minimum capacity requirements let teams specify MinInstanceCount, and cluster operations track scaling requests.
Today, we launched cluster extensions, which bring the same approach to the software and settings on running nodes, with managed extensions for observability and user management.

HyperPod supports two cluster managed extensions today: The observability extension (sagemaker-observability) collects node, GPU, Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA), Slurm job, and Slurm cluster metrics and sends them to Amazon CloudWatch or Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus .

articles.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
articles.descEn: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
articles.titleEn: Combatting adversarial distillation
summaryLinesEn: The average attack success rate fell from 54.0% against GPT‑6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% against GPT‑6.2 Astra with its updated safeguards.
Our September disclosure described attacks that moved encrypted reasoning from one conversation into another and asked the model to reveal the reasoning in user-readable form.
Our objective is to constrain the volume and value of the data distillers are able to obtain, to increase the cost of distillation campaigns, and to shorten the time needed to respond to new attacks.

articles.title: Foxconn's next chapter: Why Apple's iPhone maker is betting big on AI
articles.descEn: Hon Hai Technology Group, better known as Foxconn, is betting on AI infrastructure to drive its next phase of growth. Chairman Young Liu speaks with Christine Tan about its partnership with Nvidia, electric vehicle ambitions and push into space-based computing. He also reflects on the challenges of succeeding founder Terry Gou and shaping Foxconn’s future.
articles.titleEn: Foxconn's next chapter: Why Apple's iPhone maker is betting big on AI
summaryLinesEn: Hon Hai Technology Group, better known as Foxconn, is betting on AI infrastructure to drive its next phase of growth.
Chairman Young Liu tellsChristine Tan that AI infrastructure could account for more than 60% to 65% of the company's revenue within three to five years.
He discusses Foxconn's partnership with Nvidia, growing demand for AI servers and data centers, and why he sees no signs of AI overcapacity.
articles.summary:
Hon Hai Technology Group, better known as Foxconn, is betting on AI infrastructure to drive its next phase of growth.
Chairman Young Liu tellsChristine Tan that AI infrastructure could account for more than 60% to 65% of the company's revenue within three to five years.
He discusses Foxconn's partnership with Nvidia, growing demand for AI servers and data centers, and why he sees no signs of AI overcapacity.

summaryLines: Foxconn으로 더 잘 알려진 Hon Hai Technology Group은 다음 단계의 성장을 추진하기 위해 AI 인프라에 투자하고 있음

articles.descEn: GLOBALFOUNDRIES (NasdaqGS:GFS) plans to expand its robotics partnership with Boston Dynamics across its semiconductor fabrication plants worldwide. First on site trials of Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot at GlobalFoundries fabs are scheduled to begin in 2027. articles.title: Small businesses use social media and AI | About Verizon
articles.descEn: A new Verizon Business survey reveals small business owners rely on social media and AI tools to drive holiday sales and streamline operations.
articles.titleEn: Small businesses use social media and AI | About Verizon
summaryLinesEn: BASKING RIDGE, N.J. —As small businesses gear up for the demanding holiday season, a new survey from Verizon Business reveals that owners are turning to their own social media savvy and AI to drive sales and manage operations.

Rather than relying on Black Friday, Cyber Monday or other major retail tentpole moments, small business owners are prioritizing direct customer engagement and digital storefronts to capture holiday demand.

To explore solutions and resources designed to help small businesses manage peak demand, streamline operations, and secure their connections, visit: Verizon’s Small Business Solutions About the survey Verizon Business surveyed 600 U.S. small business owners and decision-makers at businesses with 1 – 500 employees, including an oversample of 100 Hispanic/Latino respondents.

localization.title: 중소기업은 소셜 미디어와 AI를 사용합니다 | 버라이존 소개
summaryLines: BASKING RIDGE, N.J · — 소기업들이 까다로운 휴가 시즌을 준비하면서 Verizon Business의 새로운 설문조사에 따르면 소유주들이 판매를 촉진하고 운영을 관리하기 위해 소셜 미디어에 능숙하고 AI를 활용하고 있는 것으로 나타남
블랙 프라이데이, 사이버 먼데이 또는 기타 소매업의 주요 순간에 의존하는 대신 중소기업 소유자는 휴일 수요를 포착하기 위해 직접적인 고객 참여 및 디지털 매장에 우선순위를 두고 있음

중소기업이 최대 수요를 관리하고, 운영을 간소화하고, 연결을 보호하는 데 도움이 되도록 고안된 솔루션과 리소스를 살펴보려면 다음을 방문하십시오 · Verizon의 중소기업 솔루션 설문 조사 정보 Verizon Business는 100명의 히스패닉/라틴계 응답자를 포함하여 600명의 미국 중소기업 소유주와 직원 수 1~500명 규모 기업의 의사 결정자를 대상으로 설문조사를 실시함

articles.title: AI isn’t replacing your job. It’s turning it into low-paid gig work
articles.descEn: Platform companies are luring doctors, lawyers, and Ph.D.s with top rates before applying the pay cuts and sudden ghosting that data workers have faced.
articles.titleEn: AI isn’t replacing your job. It’s turning it into low-paid gig work
summaryLinesEn: The site offers up to $7.50 an hour for Tagalog work in the Philippines for the same job, and up to $12.50 an hour for Swahili in Tanzania.
As workers fought in Kenya, Meta moved the work to West Africa.
One woman I interviewed was confined to her home during the Covid-19 pandemic by a health condition and couldn’t risk losing the job.

articles.title: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style
articles.descEn: Are the recent outages in the airline booking systems, banking platforms, and productivity platforms really a coincidence? There's actually likely something deeper going on, cybersecurity experts say.
articles.titleEn: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style
summaryLinesEn: “It’s not rapid adoption of AI yet causing these outages,” she said.

In less technical terms, she said the outage may have been caused (and preliminary findings point to this) when the FAA was trying to modernize its telecommunications infrastructure and the transition overwhelmed parts of its legacy hardware, where the new tech likely operated at a normal modern capacity while the legacy hardware couldn’t keep up.
Organizations need a more steadfast approach to AI adoption, including more testing and prioritizing what needs to be fixed and when, DeWalt said.

localization.title: 이러한 기술 중단으로 인해 AI 에이전트 스타일인 Y2K가 제공됨
summaryLines: “AI가 빠르게 채택되지 않아 이러한 중단이 발생하고 있음” · 라고 그녀는 말함
덜 기술적인 용어로 그녀는 FAA가 통신 인프라를 현대화하려고 시도하고 전환으로 인해 레거시 하드웨어가 따라잡을 수 없는 동안 새로운 기술이 정상적인 최신 용량으로 작동할 가능성이 있는 레거시 하드웨어의 일부를 압도했을 때 정전이 발생했을 수 있다고 말했습니다(그리고 예비 조사 결과는 이를 지적합니다)
조직은 더 많은 테스트를 수행하고 수정해야 할 사항과 시기의 우선순위를 지정하는 등 AI 채택에 대한 보다 확고한 접근 방식이 필요하다고 DeWalt는 말함

articles.title: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
articles.descEn: Token prices for AI models fell 21 percent in six weeks while usage volume hit a record high, according to the Ramp AI Index. Anthropic dominates with nearly 59 percent of token spending. Data from Ramp, Stripe and OpenRouter independently show the same pattern: the AI industry is still growing, but revenue momentum is cooling.
articles.titleEn: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
summaryLinesEn: The average price per million tokens for OpenAI and Anthropic combined fell to $0.45, according to Ramp, down 11.2 percent from the prior month.
In the week ending November 15, 2026, Anthropic accounted for 58.7 percent of all token spending, according to the Ramp AI Index , up 1.7 percentage points from the prior month.

In October 2026 , 56.8 percent of all tracked US companies paid for AI products or services, according to Ramp, up one percentage point from September and 13.3 percentage points more than a year earlier.

articles.title: Resolve AI's SRE-1 model finds root causes of production alerts as AI agents go on call - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Resolve AI's SRE-1 model finds root causes of production alerts as AI agents go on call - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Resolve AI's SRE-1 model finds root causes of production alerts as AI agents go on call - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Up to 80% of paged alerts in production are said to be handled by Primary On-call without escalation.
Once it has acted, the agent checks the fix against the production baseline, monitoring it until recovery holds.
Customers have reported a tenfold improvement in mean time to resolution, along with root-cause accuracy of up to 95%, according to Resolve AI.

articles.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
articles.descEn: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.
articles.titleEn: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
summaryLinesEn: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit Julie Bort Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO Julie Bort FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’ Zack Whittaker Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang Anthony Ha Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says Ivan Mehta

Google also only recently began admitting early testers to try its revamped “CC” AI agent, announced in September , which is designed to help families stay organized across email, calendars, chats, and tasks.
The feature is initially available in English in the U.S. and requires the Gemini app for Mac and a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription.

Follow Follow 모든 기술 보기 Google은 새로운 컴퓨터 사용 기능을 통해 Gemini가 양식 작성 및 창의적인 작업 흐름과 같은 작업에 더 나은 도움을 줄 수 있다고 말함

articles.title: Ubisoft lays off 166 more workers, opens a generative AI studio - Engadget
articles.descEn: Even Rockstar developers fear layoffs, as GTA 6 rakes in billions of dollars.
articles.titleEn: Ubisoft lays off 166 more workers, opens a generative AI studio - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Unsurprisingly, 55 percent of respondents said generative AI is having a negative effect on the industry.
GamesIndustry.biz reports that the cuts are mostly in production and support roles tied to canceled or reworked projects.
Take-Two described the game's preorders as reaching "unprecedented levels," and analysts estimate nearly $2 billion in first-day sales alone.

articles.title: Enterprise AI infrastructure moves beyond GPUs - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Enterprise AI infrastructure is evolving beyond GPUs as agentic workloads drive demand for CPUs, secure execution, data sovereignty and cloud platforms.
articles.titleEn: Enterprise AI infrastructure moves beyond GPUs - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Enterprise AI is pushing cloud infrastructure beyond the GPU Enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence is creating new requirements for enterprise AI infrastructure.
That shift is creating an opportunity for neocloud providers, but it is also changing what enterprises expect from them.
Infrastructure providers increasingly need to support the full application lifecycle rather than simply supply specialized hardware.

articles.title: Google's latest midtier model Gemini 4 Neon is three times faster than Carbon and wins on some metrics - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Google's latest midtier model Gemini 4 Neon is three times faster than Carbon and wins on some metrics - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Google's latest midtier model Gemini 4 Neon is three times faster than Carbon and wins on some metrics - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Everpure beats expectations as AI accelerates revenue growth for ninth straight quarter Six days, six outages: Why reliability isn't resilience Google Cloud brings AI agents to the supercomputing bottleneck Google upgrades Gemini’s agentic Task mode with new model, e-commerce features Anthropic's record-breaking IPO priced at $83 per share, higher than expected Fintech startup Payhawk valued at $2B in $280M round CLOUD - BY MARIA DEUTSCHER .
Surprisingly, though Carbon is positioned as the company’s strongest model, Neon’s performance surpassed it on some tasks, according to benchmarks the company published today.
Google said it’s priced at a cost of $3 per million input tokens, 15 cents per million cached input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.

summaryLinesEn: “What we’re seeing, for example, with computer-aided engineering, is that you can actually identify ahead of time which are non-essential parameters and you don’t run the simulation, thereby reducing the total simulation time,” she said.
The metric that matters is shifting from peak performance to time to discovery.

Researchers need more compute than any single site can provide, and cloud providers are now pitching AI agents as the layer that ties scattered resources together, according to Annie Ma-Weaver (pictured, left), head of high-performance computing product at Google Cloud, a unit of Google LLC.

articles.title: AI infrastructure economics favor Vultr's global footprint - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: AI infrastructure economics now reward proven ROI, and Vultr's Kevin Cochrane says global reach and sovereignty rules shape cloud decisions.
articles.titleEn: AI infrastructure economics favor Vultr's global footprint - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Sovereignty is the AI story everyone mentions and few have planned for ahead of 2027 AI infrastructure economics are entering a more sober phase as enterprises move past standing up AI factories and start asking how to run them profitably.
That shift rewards cloud providers with an operating track record rather than a single speculative wager.
Enterprises are now making a flight to quality toward stable, cost-efficient platforms, according to Kevin Cochrane (pictured), chief marketing officer of Vultr.

articles.title: Superhuman unveils personal AI assistant and expands Go across entire suite - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Superhuman unveils personal AI assistant and expands Go across entire suite - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Superhuman unveils personal AI assistant and expands Go across entire suite - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: “Superhuman is solving for the last mile of AI: the gap between deployment and adoption,” said Chief Executive Shishir Mehrotra.

Anthropic PBC also recently launched Claude Duet , a similar proactive AI agent for professionals and small businesses in private preview, that completes tasks when asked and keeps working in the background.
The company said the new Go assistant acts like an extra set of eyes and ears, watching out for users throughout their day, finding tasks they need to do, and keeping up with their “need to know.”

articles.title: Canva will let users switch off most generative AI - Engadget
articles.descEn: Canva is rolling out new settings to purge most generative AI from its app.
articles.titleEn: Canva will let users switch off most generative AI - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The library setting can be reached by navigating to "Your Account" and then the AI personalization section.
That's because those options don't leverage generative AI, only the content of an existing image, and using those features doesn't add the AI tag to the resulting image's metadata.
For managing the platform-wide AI tools, it's under the "permissions" section of the settings menu, with the text "Enable generative AI features."

articles.descEn: Pebble’s AI ring has a single purpose, is cheap and low-tech — but it’s very useful.
articles.titleEn: Pebble Index 01 AI ring review: When a single feature becomes the product - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The company is currently fulfilling Indiegogo orders, where rings were priced at $139, but says its retail price will be $199 when it launches.

When active, you need to hold the ring less than a foot away from your mouth to issue your edict (any further is probably physically impossible anyway), and within about 10 seconds it'll be processed on your phone.
Another option is Aina's far fancier ring , which was announced at the start of November and will ship early next year for $399.

articles.title: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
articles.descEn: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in seven weeks, which is nearly 2x faster than its sibling Carbon, outperforms it on most benchmarks and comes in at a significantly lower price.
articles.titleEn: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
summaryLinesEn: Ad According to Artificial Analysis, per-task costs for Neon at xhigh come in at $6.44, roughly 17 percent below Carbon's undiscounted figure of $7.76.

Ad The Cost Advantage Comes from List Price, Not Token Efficiency Through Google AI Studio and Gemini for Business , one million input tokens costs three dollars (or $0.15 when cached) and one million output tokens costs fifteen dollars.
In Google's own evaluations, Neon also leads individual categories on the Vals Index , Zapier's AutomationBench (56.3 percent) and science tests such as RiemannBench (84.0 percent).

articles.descEn: In some of these instances, employees said Muse surfaced messages about childcare requests they never made, career advice they never asked for, product orders they never placed, and bank account balances that didn't belong to them.
articles.titleEn: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says
summaryLinesEn: Meta employees have raised concerns that the company’s AI agent Muse has been mixing up conversations across different accounts and exposing private user data, according to a new Reuters report that looked at internal company posts.
Launched in September, Muse is one of the fastest-growing apps on record, with more than 10 million downloads.
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.

articles.title: Employees call out Google over AI Search in schools - Engadget
articles.descEn: The Alphabet Workers Union voiced concern over Google requiring its AI tools be bundled with Search.
articles.titleEn: Employees call out Google over AI Search in schools - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The claim seems to dismiss Google's decades of operation before it even launched Gemini and other public-facing AI tools.
Earlier this month, Google set out a policy that would essentially require schools to have some AI features enabled in order for their students to use the company's Search tools.
"Cutting off access to Search for schools that don't wish to use AI will not help persuade our users, and will more likely result in them shutting out Google products altogether."

articles.title: Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant’s Worst Enemy—Itself
articles.descEn: Investors betting a barnstorming $107 billion will weigh whether the company’s AI safety strategy and growing public anger towards data centers could impact its growth.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant’s Worst Enemy—Itself
summaryLinesEn: After closing the largest initial public offering in history on Wednesday, Anthropic has about $200 billion in the bank, more than every tech giant besides Alphabet.
For some time, OpenAI was expected to go public first, but executive departures , shifting priorities , and legal troubles have introduced roadblocks.
Because of how Anthropic must account for compensating employees with stock, it’s still wildly unprofitable—over $104 billion in losses this year through September.

articles.title: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
articles.descEn: OpenAI's internal use of coding agents is growing fast, with theoretical token costs now exceeding researchers' base salaries. Even though teams are reluctant to work without these tools, the models still produce a lot of "AI slop" beyond routine tasks.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
summaryLinesEn: In an internal, non-representative survey of 101 employees, researchers said at the median that they would rather give up 40 percent of their team's staff or 30 percent of their compute capacity than go three months without current coding agents.
Among the top 10 percent of users, that theoretical value doubled to $23,000 per day.

High success rates on routine tasks, weaknesses in code scaffolding Between March and October, the estimated success rate of autonomous agents working without human intervention on two- to four-hour tasks rose from 23 to 46 percent, according to OpenAI.

High success rates on routine tasks, weaknesses in code scaffolding Between March and October, the estimated success rate of autonomous agents working without human intervention on two- to four-hour tasks rose from 23 to 46 percent, according to OpenAI.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO will create thousands of multimillionaire employees
articles.descEn: The average Anthropic employee could be worth over $40 million after the company's IPO today, according to SEC filings and investors.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic IPO will create thousands of multimillionaire employees
summaryLinesEn: If the stock trades at $83 a share, the combined wealth of Anthropic employees will be around $232 billion, based on their share count in the filings.
Yet because many of the employees are later hires, earlier employees could have supersized gains since they've accumulated more stock.
According to SEC filings, the artificial intelligence company has generated 1.77 billion options for employees, with a strike price of $2.91 a share.

summaryLinesEn: 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- As small businesses gear up for the demanding holiday season, a new survey from Verizon Business reveals that owners are turning to their own social media savvy and AI to drive sales and manage operations.

Activating social media and community to drive sales Rather than relying on Black Friday, Cyber Monday or other major retail tentpole moments, small business owners are prioritizing direct customer engagement and digital storefronts to capture holiday demand.

localization.title: Verizon 설문조사 · 중소기업은 휴일에 소셜 미디어 및 AI를 활용함
summaryLines: 2026년 9월 19일 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 중소기업이 까다로운 휴가 시즌을 준비하면서 Verizon Business의 새로운 설문 조사에 따르면 소유자는 판매를 촉진하고 운영을 관리하기 위해 소셜 미디어에 능숙하고 AI를 활용하고 있는 것으로 나타남
판매 촉진을 위해 소셜 미디어 및 커뮤니티 활성화 블랙 프라이데이, 사이버 먼데이 또는 기타 소매업의 주요 순간에 의존하는 대신 중소기업 소유자는 휴일 수요를 포착하기 위해 직접적인 고객 참여 및 디지털 매장에 우선순위를 두고 있음

중소기업이 최대 수요를 관리하고, 운영을 간소화하고, 연결을 보호하는 데 도움이 되도록 고안된 솔루션과 리소스를 살펴보려면 다음을 방문하십시오 · Verizon의 중소기업 솔루션 설문조사 정보 Verizon Business는 100명의 히스패닉/라틴계 응답자를 포함한 600명의 미국 중소기업 소유주와 직원 수 1~500명 규모 기업의 의사 결정자를 대상으로 설문 조사를 실시함

articles.title: Google Built a Giant ‘Mirror Dimension’ Internet to Test Its Chrome AI Agents
articles.descEn: The company’s alternate-universe internet serves as a massive sandbox that allows the Chrome team to properly train AI browsing agents—without the risk of them going rogue.
articles.titleEn: Google Built a Giant ‘Mirror Dimension’ Internet to Test Its Chrome AI Agents
summaryLinesEn: To construct it, the Chrome team gathered armies of website and web app development agents guided by a purpose-built AI harness to quickly create realistic web services and data flows—down to details like entering promo codes on a shopping site or populating social media pages.
As the Google Chrome team has worked to develop AI browsing features using the company's Gemini models , they realized they need to go the extra mile to keep things from going haywire.
“Web-use” agents need to be familiar with the open internet, how to navigate real websites and platforms, and how to be hardened against web attacks.

localization.title: Google은 Chrome AI 에이전트를 테스트하기 위해 거대한 '거울 차원' 인터넷을 구축함
summaryLines: 이를 구축하기 위해 Chrome 팀은 쇼핑 사이트에 프로모션 코드를 입력하거나 소셜 미디어 페이지를 채우는 것과 같은 세부 사항에 이르기까지 현실적인 웹 서비스와 데이터 흐름을 신속하게 생성하기 위해 특수 제작된 AI 하네스의 안내에 따라 웹사이트 및 웹 앱 개발 에이전트 군대를 모았음
Google Chrome 팀은 회사의 Gemini 모델을 사용하여 AI 탐색 기능을 개발하면서 문제가 발생하지 않도록 하려면 추가 노력이 필요하다는 것을 깨달았음
"웹 사용" 에이전트는 개방형 인터넷, 실제 웹사이트와 플랫폼을 탐색하는 방법, 웹 공격에 대비하는 방법에 익숙해야 함

articles.descEn: Snapdragon X, X Plus, X2 Plus or X2 Elite? Here's how to decode the names and choose a processor that suits your needs.
articles.titleEn: Is a Laptop Powered by Snapdragon Good? What Each Snapdragon Chip Means for Your Day - CNET
summaryLinesEn: When shopping for a new laptop, you expect to spend time evaluating screen sizes, weight and colour choices.
Read on for an explanation of what “Plus” or “Elite” gets you and which Snapdragon processor may suit your needs.

These chips are built for: Battery efficiency and endurance: Using less energy during everyday tasks like browsing or document editing Mobile performance: Snappy responsiveness even when a laptop is running on battery power App compatibility: Support for many of the apps you use every day On-device AI: Built-in Neural Processing Units (NPUs) that can process certain AI tasks locally What’s the difference between Snapdragon X, X Plus, X2 Plus and X2 Elite?

articles.descEn: Anthropic has raised $81 billion in the biggest-ever IPO.
articles.titleEn: The Download: a living liver, a billion-dollar battery deal, and AI hype
summaryLinesEn: What a billion-dollar deal says about the US battery market After a tough few years littered with high-profile failures, there’s some positive news for next-generation batteries in the US: Sila has signed a deal with battery maker Panasonic Energy to supply silicon-carbon anode material that could be worth more than $1 billion.
The factory is backed by a $1.4 billion loan from the Trump administration’s Defense Department—and the industry is increasingly focused on geopolitics rather than the energy transition.
Here’s how China reached the milestone—and what it means for the future of BCIs .

articles.title: Give your agents controlled access to analyze your data and move funds
articles.descEn: Stripe Treasury now lets agents transfer funds, convert currencies, and pay vendors within limits you set. Give agents the access they need to help run your business, with customizable controls and human approvals.
articles.titleEn: Give your agents controlled access to analyze your data and move funds
summaryLinesEn: A payables agent could monitor balances across accounts, transfer funds to keep bill pay accounts topped up, and prepare vendor payments.
Now, we’re adding write access and customizable controls that enable agents to move money on Stripe.

More than 24,000 businesses already use Stripe Treasury for agents , giving agents read access to financial data to work on those tasks, including reviewing transactions, building cash flow models, and reconciling payments.

articles.title: Improving Developer Experience in the Age of Agents | Weaviate
articles.descEn: Coding agents may be changing how developers work - what does that mean for developer experience? Here's how we are starting to think about both.
articles.titleEn: Improving Developer Experience in the Age of Agents | Weaviate
summaryLinesEn: We set up several agents to run the same task in a repeatable way, and explored their logs and outputs.
Developers still need to understand the problem, give agents good instructions, set up the right environment, and verify the result.

That means a good experience needs to serve both the developer and the agent working between the developer and the product: For developers, that means helping them make sound architectural decisions, communicate their intent to agents, and verify outcomes.

articles.title: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT). This post explores when FFT outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examines the spectral properties of model weight matrices behind the quality gap, shares practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines, and shows how to get started.
articles.titleEn: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .

summaryLines: SageMaker AI의 서버리스 모델 사용자 지정을 통해 데이터 과학자와 기계 학습(ML) 엔지니어는 인프라 또는 GPU 용량 계획을 관리하지 않고도 모델 미세 조정에 집중할 수 있음
LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation)와 같은 매개변수 효율적인 미세 조정(PEFT) 방법은 LLM 매개변수의 작은 하위 집합만 업데이트하여 GPU 용량 요구 사항을 줄이는 다운스트림 작업에 대한 LLM 미세 조정을 위한 실용적인 솔루션으로 등장함
그림 4: MLflow에서 훈련 지표를 추적하는 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의 작업 전체 미세 조정에서 LoRA로 전환하려면 TrainingType.FULL을 TrainingType.LORA로 설정하는 한 가지 변경만 필요함

articles.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
articles.descEn: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.
articles.titleEn: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
summaryLinesEn: The Performance Factory is made up of four components: a task tracker with configurable workflows, a dispatch loop that assigns ready work to agents, an API that runs Codex in the cloud, and subscriptions that wake agents when something changes (such as a GitHub review comment posting or a deployment completing).
After deployment, the agent wakes up to check recovery.
The Performance Factory, which runs in the cloud and automates investigating and resolving performance problems, enables us to keep pace with the ambition of our roadmap.

summaryLinesEn: In the third quarter of 2026, average DAUs on the Kuaishou App reached 417.3 million, and average MAUs reached 818.5 million, representing year-over-year growth of 0.3% and 12.0%, respectively.

articles.title: From "Lungs Sound Clear" to a Complete Exam | Abridge — Abridge
articles.descEn: Casey Hribar, MD shows how Abridge turns what you say in the room into a structured, accurate physical exam, and how to set it up the way you practice.
articles.titleEn: From "Lungs Sound Clear" to a Complete Exam | Abridge — Abridge
summaryLinesEn: Before your next clinic day, open Abridge on web or desktop and go to your preferences and settings to set up your exam the way you’d like it.
My note needs an exam that keeps right and left straight, explains the findings that support the diagnosis, and includes normal observations from what I examined without claiming anything I didn’t.
The exam needs to be in a specific structure that is rarely narrative in nature.

articles.title: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
articles.descEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report reveal the benefits and challenges of implementing AI.
articles.titleEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
summaryLinesEn: For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.

Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.

articles.title: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
articles.descEn: Discover HFS Research’s new framework for trusted, enterprise-grade LLMs and learn how WRITER’s agent supervision suite and Palmyra X5 model help CIOs govern and scale agentic AI safely across the business.
articles.titleEn: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
summaryLinesEn: Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.

Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

A workload migration becomes a review-and-approve step rather than a research project.

articles.title: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to run two memory-bounded Kubernetes Pods on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU using open-source NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS. This walkthrough builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 image, installs KAI Scheduler and the GPU Fractioning Operator, and validates per-Pod GPU-memory contracts with enforcement and metrics.
articles.titleEn: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Two Pods each requesting nvidia.com/gpu: 1 cannot run concurrently on that node, even when their combined GPU-memory demand fits.
Its GPU Fractioning Operator can help several teams share one or two GPUs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) .
We validated this walkthrough on October 22, 2026, using NVIDIA driver 615.71.10.

articles.title: Small businesses, big results: How teams scale with AI
articles.descEn: See how small businesses scale using Google Workspace with Gemini to automate tasks and boost revenue. Get the details on these AI-driven results.
articles.titleEn: Small businesses, big results: How teams scale with AI
summaryLinesEn: Behind almost every small business is a small team wearing every hat at once: running sales, marketing, and logistics on the shop floor — or on the go.
In 2025, when Elan Halpern’s homemade yogurt experiments outgrew her kitchen, she and her co-founder, Kiki Couchman, launched their probiotic Greek yogurt brand, Sourmilk .
With a little help from Gemini, the duo has been able to operate like a 10-person team and scale into more than 100 grocery stores within the brand’s first year.

articles.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1, a reasoning model built for real-time complex dialog, is available today on AWS Marketplace and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. Discover it, evaluate it on your own data, and deploy it to a secure SageMaker endpoint in your own AWS account.
articles.titleEn: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Dialog-RSN-1 shows up in the SageMaker JumpStart catalog with overview and sample notebooks in one place, so your team can understand the model before spending a dollar on infrastructure.
Because the model reasons directly over the caller’s audio, it picks up tone, hesitation, and timing, the signals a plain transcript loses, and decides for itself the right moment to respond.
From the same model card you choose Deploy, and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart stands up a real-time inference endpoint with a pre-configured serving stack.
articles.summary:
Dialog-RSN-1 shows up in the SageMaker JumpStart catalog with overview and sample notebooks in one place, so your team can understand the model before spending a dollar on infrastructure.
Because the model reasons directly over the caller’s audio, it picks up tone, hesitation, and timing, the signals a plain transcript loses, and decides for itself the right moment to respond.
From the same model card you choose Deploy, and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart stands up a real-time inference endpoint with a pre-configured serving stack.
