articles.title: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
articles.descEn: Sierra today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation. The award was presented to Bret Taylor, Co-founder and CEO of Sierra, at J.P. Morgan’s 18th annual Technology Innovation Symposium.
articles.titleEn: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
summaryLinesEn: Established in 2011, the Hall of Innovation recognises privately held technology companies that have made a significant impact at JPMorganChase through their innovation, business value, and close collaboration with the firm’s teams.
Sierra, the leading customer experience AI platform, today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation.

“Agentic AI has the potential to create simpler, more intuitive experiences for customers, but realising that potential requires getting trust, security and controls right from the start,” said Gill Haus, Chief Information Officer of Chase.

summaryLines: 2011년에 설립된 혁신의 전당(Hall of Innovation)은 혁신, 비즈니스 가치 및 회사 팀과의 긴밀한 협력을 통해 JPMorganChase에 중대한 영향을 미친 비상장 기술 기업을 표창함

articles.title: How partners use Genie's free tier on Azure Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Every Azure Databricks user gets $10 of free Genie usage a month. See how partners use Genie budgets to roll out AI to every user with predictable costs.
articles.titleEn: How partners use Genie's free tier on Azure Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Every Azure Databricks user gets $10 of free Genie usage a month, and Genie budgets let admins control any spend beyond it.

Some customers block consumption-based AI tools entirely, and others hold off on a trial because they worry about what happens to costs as usage grows.

articles.title: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call. Added as a gateway interceptor, Skyflow de-identifies data before any tool, model, or log sees it, and restores it for authorized callers, with no change to your agent code.
articles.titleEn: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The Skyflow interceptor de-identifies data before it reaches a tool, restores it before the agent reads the result, and replaces documents with clean copies before the agent opens them.
The controls need to sit where every tool call passes, so authorization, content safety, and data protection apply the same way to every agent and tool.
In this post, we show how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call, and out of the model context those tools feed.

articles.title: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI gives your application one invocation path across the endpoints and inference components you already run, in one or more AWS Regions and AWS accounts. The router prefers its own Region and shifts new requests to another destination only when the local one can't serve reliably.
articles.titleEn: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Serving a model from more than one AWS Region is a well-established pattern for highly available inference: when one Region runs short of GPU capacity, requests move to another.

To use that capacity, your application must detect a struggling endpoint and switch Regions, decide which errors are safe to retry without running the model twice, move traffic back after recovery without flapping, and manage access to endpoints in other accounts.
When autoscaling can’t add instances of the type your endpoint needs, requests throttle and time out, even when the same model has spare capacity in another Region.

articles.title: From learning to leaderboard: How Cisco upskilled 1,200 engineers in agentic AI with AWS AI League | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Cisco and AWS used Cisco Transformation Fest and AWS AI League to turn hands-on AI learning into a culture of building. A Cisco engineer won the 2025 AWS AI League global title and 1,200 engineers competed in 2026. This post shares Cisco's journey, lessons from the 2026 winning agent built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and how to host your own league.
articles.titleEn: From learning to leaderboard: How Cisco upskilled 1,200 engineers in agentic AI with AWS AI League | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The program is built on five tenets the team summarized as SCALE : Figure 3: 2026 Cisco AWS Transformation Fest 4.0 AWS AI League finalists Transformation Fest brings together several formats: AWS GameDays, AWS AI League, sessions where Cisco leaders share best practices and success stories with peers, and sessions on Amazon and AWS culture.

It turns hands-on AI learning into a gamified competition, where participants customize models and build agents on AWS, get instant feedback on a live leaderboard, and compete in a game-show-style finale.
In this post, we share how Cisco and AWS used Cisco Transformation Fest and AWS AI League to build a lasting culture of learning by doing.

articles.title: Optimize AI economics on Amazon Bedrock with Accenture’s sequenced approach | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: As enterprises scale AI on Amazon Bedrock, token spend can grow even as per-token prices fall. This post walks through six composable optimization levers, shows how Accenture applied them across four client engagements, and recommends a sequence for cutting AI token spend on your own workloads.
articles.titleEn: Optimize AI economics on Amazon Bedrock with Accenture’s sequenced approach | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Distilled models in Amazon Bedrock are up to 500 percent faster and up to 75 percent less expensive than original models, with less than 2 percent accuracy loss for use cases such as RAG.
Amazon Bedrock batch inference processes non-urgent workloads asynchronously as a group at 50 percent lower cost than on-demand pricing for select models (see Amazon Bedrock Pricing ).

In an AWS benchmark on 63,796 real chatbot queries, a 0.90 similarity threshold produced a 74.5 percent cache hit rate, 92.3 percent accuracy, and 72.5 percent cost savings ( see ElastiCache semantic caching benchmarks ).

articles.title: In Wake of Democrats’ Midterm Victory, Majority of Americans Approve of the Party’s Policies and Plans
articles.descEn: More Americans say Democratic congressional leaders will have the better approach to several issues than say Trump will – by double-digit margins.
articles.titleEn: In Wake of Democrats’ Midterm Victory, Majority of Americans Approve of the Party’s Policies and Plans
summaryLinesEn: A similar share (55%) approve of Democratic congressional leaders’ policies and plans for the country, according to a new Pew Research Center survey.
Republican opinion on this question has shifted since January of this year, when 61% of Republicans said Trump should stand up to Democratic leaders and 37% said he should try to work with them.
By an 18-point margin, more Americans say congressional Democrats will have the better approach to the economy (45%) than say Trump will (27%).

articles.title: How we’re putting one of quantum mechanics’ deepest features to the test at scale.
articles.descEn: Google Quantum AI research proves contextuality powers quantum algorithms at scale. See how our processor beat classical limits. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: How we’re putting one of quantum mechanics’ deepest features to the test at scale.
summaryLinesEn: Using it, our qubits won a well-known coordination game 98.3% of the time, beating the 88.9% classical limit, and outperformed constrained classical strategies in tasks spanning up to 105 qubits.
In simple terms, contextuality means a system’s properties aren’t fixed in advance; what you measure depends on which other compatible measurements you make alongside it.

Today, in new research published on the cover of Science , Google Quantum AI demonstrated that contextuality — a quantum property scientists believe powers certain quantum algorithms — survives at scale on our quantum processor.

summaryLines: 이를 사용하여 우리의 큐비트는 잘 알려진 조정 게임에서 98.3%의 시간 동안 승리하여 88.9%의 클래식 한계를 극복했으며 최대 105큐비트에 걸친 작업에서 제한된 클래식 전략보다 성능이 뛰어났음
간단히 말해서 상황성은 시스템의 속성이 미리 고정되지 않음을 의미함 · 측정하는 내용은 이와 함께 수행하는 다른 호환 가능한 측정에 따라 달라짐
오늘 Science 표지에 발표된 새로운 연구에서 Google Quantum AI는 과학자들이 특정 양자 알고리즘을 강화한다고 믿는 양자 속성인 상황성(Contextuality)이 양자 프로세서에서 대규모로 살아남는다는 것을 보여주었음

articles.descEn: Learn four AI architecture patterns for combining enterprise agents with deterministic controls, human authority and bounded autonomy in regulated industries.

These four patterns help architects decide where agents can reason, act, and remain subject to controls or human authority.
Agents can reason through complex problems, but enterprise systems-especially in regulated industries-must remain controlled and auditable.

articles.title: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Voice cloning in Amazon Polly is now generally available. Give Amazon Polly a few minutes of recordings from a consenting speaker, and it builds a custom voice that reads new text in that speaker's voice. Cloned voices run on the Amazon Polly generative engine and support seven languages.
articles.titleEn: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Building a cloned voice is free for Amazon Polly customers, and Amazon Polly charges for cloned voice usage on a pay-as-you-go basis, see Amazon Polly Pricing page for details.
Hannah: a real recording, then her cloned voice on a support line.
You can send up to 10 recordings per voice, and up to 15 minutes of audio in total.

articles.descEn: NVIDIA and Microsoft expand tools for enterprises to customize AI models and deploy applications across cloud and local infrastructure.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
summaryLinesEn: In MLPerf Inference v6.1 , Azure’s NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems led cloud submissions on DeepSeek-R1 interactive throughput by over 10%, per Signal65.
Alongside expanding customer access to NVIDIA technologies, Microsoft is using NVIDIA software and accelerated computing in its own AI development and services.

articles.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness adds Strands harness defaults, built-in tools, and lifecycle hooks | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness now runs on the open-source Strands harness, bringing a recommended model, task-oriented defaults, automatic prompt caching, proactive context management, and new built-in tools. It also adds lifecycle hooks so you can run deterministic allow or deny checks at defined points in the agent loop.
articles.titleEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness adds Strands harness defaults, built-in tools, and lifecycle hooks | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: AgentCore achieves this by connecting the harness to the services required for production agents, including session persistence, streaming responses, usage metadata, observability, AgentCore memory, Identity, Gateway, Browser, Code Interpreter, and customer-provided containers.
Large tool results can be moved out of the immediate model context.
The agent still needs tools, instructions for finishing the job, a way to manage context growth in long sessions, and guardrails before it executes any consequential actions, like issuing a refund.

articles.title: Genie One Accuracy: Why Curated Agents Need Governed Context | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: See how curated Genie Agents and modeled knowledge in Genie Ontology raised Genie One accuracy to 95% on 125 questions, and how to apply it to your data.
articles.titleEn: Genie One Accuracy: Why Curated Agents Need Governed Context | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Across 125 questions about a fictional insurer, Genie One scored 93–95% using curated Genie Agents together with governed business context (Metric Views, Domains/Subdomains and Pages), 83% with either agents or the governed layer alone, and 64% with tables alone.
In a separate change test, updating one Metric View and its Page moved all 12 related Genie One answers to the new definition without any agent edits.

Metric Views, Domains, Subdomains, and Pages help Genie One answer definition questions that would otherwise rely on tribal knowledge, while agents are needed for questions that require answers from unstructured data such as PDFs.
articles.summary:

articles.title: Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: For organizations hiring hundreds or thousands of people, every interview presents the same challenge: How do you give candidates a consistent opportunity to demonstrate their skills while gathering the evidence needed to make informed hiring decisions? Structured behavioral interviews offer a research-backed approach to this challenge. They use consistent, job-related questions and clear scoring criteria […]
articles.titleEn: Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Scoring alignment reached 97.6% when candidates provided clear evidence and 92.9% when only considering candidate concern signals, which identify behaviors that may indicate a poor fit for the intended role .

Decades of research in industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology have shown that structured interviews help organizations evaluate candidates and predict job performance (Schmidt & Hunter, 1998; Sackett et al., 2022).

Connect Talent uses structured questions, adaptive follow-ups, and evidence-based scoring to help organizations gather consistent, job-related information while giving more candidates the opportunity to demonstrate their strengths.

localization.title: Amazon Connect Talent 살펴보기 · 구조화된 AI 인터뷰의 과학 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: 후보자가 명확한 증거를 제공한 경우 점수 정렬은 97.6%에 이르렀고, 의도한 역할에 적합하지 않음을 나타낼 수 있는 행동을 식별하는 후보자의 우려 신호만 고려한 경우에는 92.9%에 도달함
산업-조직(I-O) 심리학에 대한 수십 년간의 연구에 따르면 구조화된 인터뷰는 조직이 후보자를 평가하고 업무 성과를 예측하는 데 도움이 되는 것으로 나타났습니다(Schmidt & Hunter, 1998; Sackett et al., 2022)
Connect Talent는 구조화된 질문, 적응형 후속 조치, 증거 기반 채점을 사용하여 조직이 일관적인 직무 관련 정보를 수집하는 동시에 더 많은 후보자에게 자신의 강점을 보여줄 수 있는 기회를 제공하도록 돕음

articles.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now detects latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your inference endpoints | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker AI now monitors your generative AI inference endpoints by default and tells you when a change could improve performance or lower cost. It tracks latency, GPU utilization, and serving configuration, then sends a finding through AWS Health with a one-click path to benchmark alternatives in SageMaker Studio before you apply any change.
articles.titleEn: Amazon SageMaker AI now detects latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your inference endpoints | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: A representative notification reads as follows: Subject: [Action may be required] SageMaker AI inference improvements for your endpoint SageMaker AI tracks the latency and capacity usage of your inference endpoints by default, and found improvements for one of them.

Amazon SageMaker AI now monitors your generative AI inference endpoints and tells you when a change could improve performance or lower cost by using Generative AI optimized inference recommendations feature with Agentic experience in Amazon SageMaker Studio .

Traffic patterns evolve, prompts grow longer, serving engines such as vLLM ship new releases, SageMaker inference develops new optimization techniques, and new fine-tuned checkpoints change the resources your model needs.

articles.titleEn: Genie ZeroOps, now in public beta: An autonomous agent that fixes data pipelines, with lessons from 80,000 customer issues | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: In June we introduced Genie ZeroOps , an autonomous agent that detects, investigates, and resolves data pipeline issues, such as upstream schema changes or data quality anomalies.

So we built shared inboxes, custom agent instructions, and one-click PRs to help data teams triage faster. by Jeff Chou , Kristóf Molnár , Lennart Kats , Danny Chiao and Ray Zhu Genie ZeroOps is built and refined from observations across over 80,000 customer pipeline issues.

Based on extensive private preview testing with hundreds of customers, we’ve added new features to help data teams triage issues faster - including inbox sharing, notifications, one-click PR creation, and the ability to add custom business instructions to follow specific company workflows.

articles.title: Why PostgreSQL 19 shipped late | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: PostgreSQL 19 shipped about a month after the usual September to October window for major PostgreSQL releases. The delay came from the project's focus on quality.
articles.titleEn: Why PostgreSQL 19 shipped late | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: CVEs fixed per quarterly update release went from one to four up to 28 by August 2026, and commits back-patched to the release branch rose 61%.
The project is adapting, and AI scrutiny is a chance to make PostgreSQL better than it's ever been.
The delay came from the project's focus on quality.

The delay came from the project's focus on quality.

articles.title: How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: When hundreds of agents serve thousands of developers, governance cannot be an afterthought. The BMW Group shares the practices and patterns its R&D teams use to build, govern, and operate AI agents at enterprise scale without sacrificing speed, quality, or compliance.
articles.titleEn: How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: At the BMW Group’s R&D, more than 12,500 developers work on approximately 500 million lines of vehicle software code.
While research, frameworks, and guidelines now facilitate building agents, industrializing and operating high-quality agents in an efficient, scalable manner remains a significant challenge.
This software is augmented by the BMW Connected Vehicle backend, a cloud-based system of more than 1,300 microservices providing digital services for 24 million vehicles in the field.

articles.title: Enable AI agents to pay for AWS Marketplace x402 products with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments now supports AWS Marketplace, so agents can discover and buy x402-enabled products, APIs, data, and content and pay in USD on the developer's AWS bill, with no stablecoin wallets or API keys. This post walks through a research agent that finds a tool, pays per request through AWS Billing, and answers with sources.
articles.titleEn: Enable AI agents to pay for AWS Marketplace x402 products with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In this test run against a $0.01 seller, it compared two listings before buying: When the run finishes, the sample will print the payment with its amount, AWS Marketplace product ID, and processPaymentId .

Today we extend that autonomy to AWS Marketplace , so agents can discover and buy x402-enabled software, APIs, data, and content, and pay in USD on the agent developer’s AWS bill, removing the need for stablecoin wallets or API keys.

Existing guardrails carry over, developers can set spending limits and approved sellers using AgentCore policy, and the payment session cap is enforced by AgentCore payments, so an agent is unable to overspend.

articles.title: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers enhanced observability to help you diagnose GPU training issues faster. It brings together diagnostic and profiling capabilities for training workloads on both Amazon EKS and Slurm orchestrators, pinpointing issues across GPU, network, and host layers.
articles.titleEn: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Enhanced observability collects telemetry at two levels: Default metrics (enabled automatically) cover cluster health, CPU/disk/OS-level usage, GPU utilization and temperature, and per-job resource utilization.

articles.title: When tech workers have to quit their jobs to raise the alarm, it’s time to worry | Isabelle Ferreras
articles.descEn: We have no hope of making AI safe for humanity if tech bosses are allowed to run their companies like autocracies, says sociologist Isabelle Ferreras
articles.titleEn: When tech workers have to quit their jobs to raise the alarm, it’s time to worry | Isabelle Ferreras
summaryLinesEn: Remember what happened at Meta over the summer: Mark Zuckerberg’s firm faced a backlash from employees after Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp introduced a tool that tracked staff keystrokes, mouse clicks and content displayed on computer screens to collect data for training its AI models.
Tech workers also need a collective standing over corporate strategy, independent channels to report safety breaches and formal representation inside frontier labs before models are deployed.

Last month, the person who oversaw safety reports for OpenAI’s product releases said he was quitting the ChatGPT creator because the company’s culture was “broken” and the entire AI industry was too careless in developing the technology.

summaryLines: 여름 동안 Meta에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지 기억해 보십시오 · Mark Zuckerberg의 회사는 Facebook, Instagram 및 WhatsApp이 AI 모델 훈련을 위한 데이터를 수집하기 위해 직원의 키 입력, 마우스 클릭 및 컴퓨터 화면에 표시되는 콘텐츠를 추적하는 도구를 도입한 후 직원들의 반발에 직면함
또한 기술 인력은 기업 전략에 대한 집단적 입장, 안전 위반을 보고할 수 있는 독립적인 채널, 모델을 배포하기 전에 프런티어 연구소 내부의 공식 대표가 필요함
지난 달 OpenAI의 제품 출시에 대한 안전 보고서를 감독한 사람은 회사의 문화가 "깨졌고" 전체 AI 산업이 기술 개발에 너무 부주의했기 때문에 ChatGPT 제작자를 그만두겠다고 말함

articles.title: Nvidia vs. Intel: One AI Stock Is Worth the Drama, the Other Isn’t Worth the Wait, Says Investor
articles.descEn: For a while, the only thing Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) had in common was that they both made chips. Nvidia rode the AI boom to become one of the world’s most valuable companies, while Intel spent years trying to repair its business. Now they share a problem: shareholders who aren’t sure what comes next. Nvidia released its third-quarter earnings report on Tuesday, its first since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, and the stock still fell the next day. Intel’s slide deepened after i
articles.titleEn: Nvidia vs. Intel: One AI Stock Is Worth the Drama, the Other Isn’t Worth the Wait, Says Investor
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia's revenue more than doubled year over year to $115.8 billion, and interim CEO Colette Kress raised the fiscal 2028 growth forecast to 75% from 70%.
TCA's model assumes revenue grows about 9% next year and allows for a recovery to a 6% net margin, roughly the sector median.
TCA also expects Nvidia to use up its remaining buyback authorization of about $227 billion by the end of fiscal 2028, as management has said it will, which would shrink the share count.

articles.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is 'unpatchable'
articles.descEn: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.
articles.titleEn: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is 'unpatchable'
summaryLinesEn: In other words: The smartification of the economy, in which much of the world’s “dumb” devices were hooked up to the internet, is now causing tremendous headaches.
“The patch [now] needs to go instantly from being available to being patched in production, because it’s being exploited in the wild, right?
“Remember, there is a lot of stuff in our critical infrastructure that’s unpatchable,” Nadella said.

articles.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
articles.descEn: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.
articles.titleEn: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
summaryLinesEn: Speaking at The New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday, the tech executive argued that the shift to an agentic web could change which companies pay others for traffic and for transactions, similar to how the transition from web portals like Yahoo to search engines like Google did years ago.
“And if you were monetizing ads because of the eyeballs, you now have to probably get down to essentially maybe CPC [cost-per-click] wins; maybe it’s more transactional,” he continued.
“The current aggregators who have a business model which was for the human web will get, in some sense, reshuffled,” said Nadella.

articles.title: Trump’s latest land grab is an AI hub in the Philippines
articles.descEn: To secure chips and critical minerals for AI, the US is turning to a former colony.
articles.titleEn: Trump’s latest land grab is an AI hub in the Philippines
summaryLinesEn: The agency says the project will be on public land located at the former Clark Air Base built in the early 1900s when the Philippines was a US territory.

At least two dozen countries have signed on to the Pax Silica initiative, and Trump was expected to pressure more to join while in the Philippines for events related to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit.
The agency expects to rake in close to $1 billion USD (about 60 billion in PHP Peso) from lease income over the first 25 years.

이 기관은 처음 25년 동안 임대 수입으로 약 10억 달러(PHP 페소로 약 600억 달러)를 벌어들일 것으로 예상하고 있음

articles.title: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
articles.descEn: While the Branch Nvidians try to reinstate Jensen Huang, Collette Kress, Nvidia’s acting CEO, has to lead the company. The earnings call hinted at how.
articles.titleEn: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
summaryLinesEn: For instance, if Elon Musk is telling the truth , then Jensen Huang (the former CEO of Nvidia, a company with a market cap of about $3 trillion) has been making deals that were “a handshake with Jensen” with suppliers — “not a written contract,” Musk wrote.
But after listening to Nvidia’s first earnings call with its new CEO, Colette Kress, I do think something may have shifted.
This is an important thing, though — as SemiAnalysis noted in its bizarrely conspiratorial post on the situation, Nvidia is successful because it has choked off the supply chain .

articles.title: Even His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AI
articles.descEn: Fallout from the Nvidia scandal has made any negotiations around AI difficult, officials say.
articles.titleEn: Even His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AI
summaryLinesEn: While Trump has sought to forge friendlier economic relations with China, the administration this week announced it would move forward with a new rule clamping down on China's ability to remotely access US-made AI chips in foreign data centers.

Back in September, the Trump administration moved to set up an AI incident hotline between Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese vice premier He Lifeng to account for situations just like this one.
Part of the reason progress hasn’t been made yet is due to differing views on what the biggest risks are with AI—and both nations have different incentives on making incidents public, officials say.

Part of the reason progress hasn’t been made yet is due to differing views on what the biggest risks are with AI—and both nations have different incentives on making incidents public, officials say.

summaryLines: 트럼프 대통령은 중국과 보다 우호적인 경제 관계를 구축하려고 노력했지만, 이번 주 행정부는 외국 데이터 센터에서 미국산 AI 칩에 원격으로 접근하는 중국의 능력을 단속하는 새로운 규정을 추진할 것이라고 발표함

아직 진전이 이루어지지 않은 이유 중 하나는 AI의 가장 큰 위험이 무엇인지에 대한 서로 다른 견해 때문이며, 두 국가 모두 사건을 공개하는 데 서로 다른 인센티브를 갖고 있다고 관계자는 말함

articles.title: America’s AI Chip War Is Heating Up in the Dumbest Possible Ways
articles.descEn: The Trump administration announced plans to clamp down on China’s access to AI chips. Apparently, the cheating scandal of the century was the motivation they were missing.
articles.titleEn: America’s AI Chip War Is Heating Up in the Dumbest Possible Ways
summaryLinesEn: According to Bloomberg, roughly 50,000 of the estimated 136,000 AI chips Megaspeed imported into Malaysia and Indonesia in 2024 and 2025 weren't accounted for in Nvidia's initial inventory checks.

The bureau's job only got harder as the Biden administration introduced successive rounds of increasingly complex restrictions, scrambling to tighten the rules as chipmakers found increasingly elaborate ways to get around them.

(A White House spokesperson previously told WIRED that the new rule would “crack down on the smuggling of advanced US SI chips” and “help ensure that America’s most advanced chips go first to US SI innovators, not Chinese shell companies.”)

localization.title: 미국의 AI 칩 전쟁이 가능한 가장 멍청한 방식으로 가열되고 있음
summaryLines: Bloomberg에 따르면 Megaspeed가 2024년과 2025년에 말레이시아와 인도네시아로 수입한 약 136,000개의 AI 칩 중 약 50,000개가 Nvidia의 초기 재고 확인에서 제외됨
Biden 행정부가 점점 더 복잡해지는 제한 사항을 연속적으로 도입하고, 칩 제조업체들이 이를 피할 수 있는 점점 더 정교한 방법을 찾으면서 규칙을 강화하기 위해 안간힘을 쓰면서 국의 업무는 더욱 어려워졌음
(백악관 대변인은 이전에 WIRED에 새로운 규정이 “첨단 미국 SI 칩의 밀수를 단속하고” “미국의 가장 진보된 칩이 중국 쉘 회사가 아닌 미국 SI 혁신가에게 먼저 전달되도록 보장하는 데 도움이 될 것”이라고 WIRED에 말했습니다.)

articles.title: AI found a hole in Java, and it starts with 'AAAAAAAA...' - Engadget
articles.descEn: The bug could let hackers take over systems at banks, hospitals and most Fortune 500 companies.
articles.titleEn: AI found a hole in Java, and it starts with 'AAAAAAAA...' - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Java is everywhere, powering platforms for banks, hospitals, airlines and government agencies; it's used by about 90 percent of Fortune 500 companies.
Researchers at cybersecurity startup Calif discovered the flaw with help from OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber model, which isn't yet publicly available.
Still, some systems will inevitably go unpatched, and Calif estimates that the bug could linger for five to 10 years.

articles.title: You can now see and edit what Google Gemini remembers about you - Engadget
articles.descEn: Editing the AI’s memory is one way you can shape its responses.
articles.titleEn: You can now see and edit what Google Gemini remembers about you - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Depending on what you share, Gemini's picture of you can be fairly intimate, which makes the ability to edit the AI's memory all the more important.
The AI isn't able to create any memories unless it can remember and access your inputs, so Keep Activity needs to be on for this to work.

Besides the ability to connect and use other applications and services, a lot of AI assistants' utility comes from their capacity to shape their responses based on what they learn and remember about you.

articles.title: Does a Laptop Powered by Snapdragon Really Last All Week? What to Expect From the HP OmniBook 3 - CNET
articles.descEn: The HP OmniBook 3 with the Snapdragon X processor is rated for up to 41 hours of battery life. Here’s how to stretch each charge.
articles.titleEn: Does a Laptop Powered by Snapdragon Really Last All Week? What to Expect From the HP OmniBook 3 - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Quick Answer: Some professionals may be able to get through a full working week on a single charge with the HP OmniBook 3 with Snapdragon X , which Currys rates at up to 41 hours of battery life.
The HP OmniBook 3 has a secret weapon for power efficiency: the first-generation Snapdragon X (the eight-core X1-26-100) processor.
If you’re putting the laptop away for the whole weekend, shutting it down (or using Hibernate if available, which uses even less power than sleep) can help preserve a charge for Monday morning.

articles.title: Business development in the agentic AI era puts CPUs first - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Business development for compute is shifting as agentic AI drives CPU demand and data center power limits shape server design and refresh plans.
articles.titleEn: Business development in the agentic AI era puts CPUs first - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: When Dell began planning its portfolio 2.5 years ago, enterprise customers forecast rack power holding at 15 to 20 kilowatts and said they often ran out of power before filling a rack, according to Schmidt.
A single EPYC 9006 server can take 13 legacy machines out of production while cutting the system power needed for cooling by 80 percent, Schmidt noted.
Agentic AI puts the CPU back at center stage as Dell and AMD chase every watt Agentic AI is rewriting the business development playbook for chipmakers and server builders.

articles.title: Memory bottlenecks in AI: How photonics and shared pools help - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Memory bottlenecks leave GPUs idle as inference grows, but photonics and shared HBM pools can cut data movement energy to a quarter of copper.
articles.titleEn: Memory bottlenecks in AI: How photonics and shared pools help - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: AI’s hidden energy tax: More than 80% of scale-up traffic is just memory moving around Memory bottlenecks are emerging as one of the costliest problems in AI infrastructure as inference overtakes training.
More than 80 percent of scale-up network traffic is memory transactions, and a shared pool means much of that data never moves at all, he noted.
Each appliance holds 16 terabytes of HBM and DDR5 memory that servers across multiple racks can share, Mills explained.

articles.descEn: FlowForma, the AI and process automation company, today launched FlowForma Agent Trust, an AI agent governance hub that brings oversight to every agent an organization runs, from any platform or vendor. It manages processes, people and agents side by side, holding AI to the same standard as a member of the team: visible, accountable and under control.
articles.titleEn: Introducing FlowForma Agent Trust: Every AI Agent, Under Control
summaryLinesEn: FlowForma Contract runs procurement, contract and tender management, FlowForma Assure speeds up vendor security assessment, and FlowForma Agent Trust governs, monitors and optimizes AI agents.

18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FlowForma , the AI and process automation company, today launched FlowForma Agent Trust , an AI agent governance hub that brings oversight to every agent an organization runs, from any platform or vendor.
FlowForma Agent Trust discovers every AI agent at work in an organization and checks what it delivers against real outcomes, human corrections and cost.

articles.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
articles.descEn: Osmo’s smell model is already being used in the fragrance industry. But are medical diagnostics and threat detection a sniff too far?
articles.titleEn: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
summaryLinesEn: A lot of the company’s work has been in creating its own dataset of more than 10 million human labels and 800 million “scent tokens,” which describe the exact molecules and concentrations that go into creating specific odors.

The Gates Foundation, which invested $5 million when Osmo launched, later gave the company a $3.5 million grant to assess molecules that repel disease-carrying insects, and Osmo identified eight substances that were more repellent than DEET.
It says its technology is already being used in the fragrance industry to help brands design and manufacture new scents.

articles.title: Over a Third of Gen Z-ers Rely on AI for Friendship
articles.descEn: Young people who have online-only friends or use AI as a social companion face higher odds of loneliness than those who do not, a new Gallup report reveals.
articles.titleEn: Over a Third of Gen Z-ers Rely on AI for Friendship
summaryLinesEn: In “ Friendship in an Online-Offline World: Digital Life, Connection and Wellbeing ” researchers from public polling firm Gallup and the Digital Wellness Lab at Boston Children’s Hospital found that more than one-third of Gen Z (33 percent) rely on AI for companionship.

While researchers are wary of classifying the report as a permanent shift in how young people form relationships, they say it does signal a growing reliance on AI companionship as part of a pattern of digital social engagement unfolding among Gen Z.

In the US, where state legislators have introduced bills to curb addictive design features, a majority of Americans support banning kids under 16 from using social media, according to a recent Pew Research survey .

localization.title: Z세대의 3분의 1 이상이 우정을 위해 AI에 의존함
summaryLines: 공공 여론 조사 회사인 Gallup과 Boston Children's Hospital의 Digital Wellness Lab의 연구원들은 “온라인-오프라인 세계의 우정 · 디지털 생활, 연결 및 웰빙”에서 Z세대의 3분의 1 이상(33%)이 동료애를 위해 AI에 의존한다는 사실을 발견함
연구자들은 이 보고서를 젊은이들이 관계를 형성하는 방식의 영구적인 변화로 분류하는 것을 경계하지만, 이는 Z세대 사이에 펼쳐지는 디지털 사회적 참여 패턴의 일부로 AI 동반자 관계에 대한 의존도가 높아지고 있음을 의미한다고 말함
최근 퓨 리서치(Pew Research) 조사에 따르면 주 의회가 중독성 있는 디자인 기능을 억제하기 위한 법안을 발의한 미국에서는 미국인 대다수가 16세 미만 어린이의 소셜 미디어 사용 금지를 지지하는 것으로 나타남

articles.title: ‘Just Ridiculous’: A Famed Philosopher Takes on AI Consciousness
articles.descEn: Thomas Nagel has done landmark work on consciousness in nonhumans; this week, he won the million-dollar Berggruen Prize for his contributions to the field. And he has a lot of thoughts on AI.
articles.titleEn: ‘Just Ridiculous’: A Famed Philosopher Takes on AI Consciousness
summaryLinesEn: Over 50 years ago, philosopher Thomas Nagel asked the question, “What Is It Like to Be a Bat?”

We have strong reasons to believe that while there may be consciousness elsewhere in the universe, it would require the appearance of some kind of organism with something analogous to a nervous system.
It’s been 52 years since you wrote “What Is It Like to Be a Bat?,” which has become an iconic paper about understanding consciousness in non-humans.

articles.title: Criminals Have a New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
articles.descEn: Artex and similar penetration testing tools allow newbie hackers to scan targeted systems for vulnerabilities and successfully wage attacks using prompts fed to chatbots.
articles.titleEn: Criminals Have a New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
summaryLinesEn: Over the past year, security researchers have warned that AI agents could vastly speed up cybercriminals’ ability to launch cyberattacks, breach companies , and ultimately steal money, data, or sensitive information from those compromised systems.
Hackers also don’t need to be skilled to use the tools, researchers say, and attacks that would have taken days are completed in just hours.

Pinpointing the number of cybercriminals using Artex and other frameworks isn’t easy; however, thousands of instances of the systems being set up have been exposed to the internet, according to analysis by Censys and the Shadowserver Foundation.

summaryLines: 지난 1년 동안 보안 연구원들은 AI 에이전트가 사이버 공격을 시작하고 회사를 침해하고 궁극적으로 손상된 시스템에서 돈, 데이터 또는 민감한 정보를 훔치는 사이버 범죄자의 능력을 크게 가속화할 수 있다고 경고함

articles.title: OpenAI opens its AI systems to four independent on-site auditors for the first time
articles.descEn: OpenAI is giving four independent audit organizations, including Apollo Research and METR, direct access to unreleased models, source code, and training data for the first time. The embedded reviews are designed to uncover hidden misbehavior and safety gaps. OpenAI can redact or delay reports, so how independent this oversight actually turns out to be remains an open question.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI opens its AI systems to four independent on-site auditors for the first time
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI and Transluce are also planning an eight-week follow-up review for early 2027.
OpenAI is giving four outside audit organizations direct access to its internal AI systems to investigate safety risks and model behavior on-site.
The company expects some friction early on but is already considering more reviews, including ones focused on company culture and internal processes.

articles.title: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
articles.descEn: The AI detection tool Pangram flags 99 percent of a prize-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but Mexican publisher Almadía is standing by the award after its own review. Pangram also classified over 80 percent of the author's personal texts as machine-written. French publisher Gallimard plans to start screening manuscripts with the tool.
articles.titleEn: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
summaryLinesEn: AI detection tool Pangram flags 99 percent of the award-winning novel "Donde el agua trabaja" by Peruvian author David Silva Rojas as AI-generated.
According to the newspaper El País, Pangram had also attributed more than 80 percent of text from interviews, an essay, and the author's Instagram denial to AI.
Despite these allegations, Mexican publisher Almadía is standing by the award after reviewing documents from the author, according to an essay in The Point Magazine .

articles.title: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
articles.descEn: Nvidia and AMD earnings show booming demand. This is why a frontier slowdown might not derail it.
articles.titleEn: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
summaryLinesEn: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink AMD rides data center riches to ‘largest and most profitable’ quarter in history Intel says it’s selling every affordable laptop chip it can make Chipmaker AMD, meanwhile, reported its biggest quarter ever earlier this month, with revenue up 45 percent to $13.4 billion .

The people building the most powerful models were warning about what those models might be capable of, and investors were suddenly wondering what would happen to chip demand if the labs eased up on new models.
The impact could show up sooner in orders placed with chip manufacturers like TSMC.

summaryLines: Qualcomm은 스마트폰 판매가 감소하는 AMD가 데이터 센터 부자들을 역사상 '가장 크고 수익성이 높은' 분기로 끌어올리면서 데이터 센터에 큰 투자를 하고 있음 · Intel은 Chipmaker AMD가 만들 수 있는 모든 저렴한 노트북 칩을 판매하고 있다고 밝힘 · 한편, Chipmaker AMD는 이번 달 초 매출이 45% 증가한 134억 달러로 역대 최대 분기를 보고함

TSMC와 같은 칩 제조업체에 주문을 하면 그 영향이 더 빨리 나타날 수 있음

articles.title: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
articles.descEn: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.
articles.titleEn: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
summaryLinesEn: The option could be convenient to use at those times when you start digging deeper into a particular topic via AI Mode and realize that you don’t want the discussion to become a part of your search history because of its personal nature.
Google’s search engine has long offered an incognito mode for all those search queries you don’t want logged or associated with your account.
Now, Google’s AI Mode in Search is getting a similar feature.

articles.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
articles.descEn: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier model built for software development, knowledge work, and science. It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs with a context window of one million tokens. At $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, Neon is priced above previous Gemini 4 models.
articles.titleEn: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
summaryLinesEn: The model is live today through the API at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, above Carbon and Argon's introductory rate of $2/$10 (doubling to $4/$20 on December 1 ) and twice the price of Hydrogen at $1.50/$7.50.
It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs, with support for Computer Use , code execution, file search, and grounding via Google Search and Maps.
It's also Google's fourth new Gemini 4 model in four weeks.

articles.title: Mirantis Joins Lenovo AI Innovators to Help Cloud Providers Turn GPU Infrastructure into AI Services
articles.descEn: CAMPBELL, Calif., November 18, 2026--Mirantis, delivering open, standards based infrastructure for the next generation of AI clouds, today announced it has joined the Lenovo AI Innovators program to help cloud providers and enterprises turn Lenovo AI infrastructure into production AI services.
articles.titleEn: Mirantis Joins Lenovo AI Innovators to Help Cloud Providers Turn GPU Infrastructure into AI Services
summaryLinesEn: For cloud providers, these capabilities make GPU capacity faster to deliver and simpler to operate at scale, and provide a foundation to offer additional managed AI services.
For enterprises, the capabilities provide a foundation for private AI environments that give teams access to accelerated computing while maintaining centralized operational control.

"Cloud providers and enterprises are investing in GPUs to deliver services, support developers and build new revenue streams," said Richard Borenstein, senior vice president of business development, Mirantis.

summaryLines: 클라우드 제공업체의 경우 이러한 기능을 통해 GPU 용량을 더 빠르게 제공하고 규모에 맞게 더 쉽게 운영할 수 있으며 추가 관리형 AI 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 기반을 제공함

Mirantis의 비즈니스 개발 담당 수석 부사장인 Richard Borenstein은 "클라우드 제공업체와 기업은 서비스를 제공하고 개발자를 지원하며 새로운 수익원을 구축하기 위해 GPU에 투자하고 있음" · 라고 말함

articles.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Could Be 46% Undervalued Following AI Factory Updates
articles.descEn: Dell Technologies (DELL) put its AI story back in focus with fresh upgrades to the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA, adding new data tools, liquid cooled storage and large scale infrastructure management. Despite the AI Factory updates, Dell Technologies’ recent share price action has cooled. The 30-day share price return is down 28.54% and the 90-day share price return is down 26.23%, while the year-to-date share price return stands at 152.57% and the 1-year total shareholder return reaches...
articles.titleEn: Dell Technologies (DELL) Could Be 46% Undervalued Following AI Factory Updates
summaryLinesEn: Dell Technologies last closed at $322.79, while the analyst consensus Narrative on Simply Wall St estimates fair value at $594.16.

Dell Technologies is experiencing accelerating demand for AI servers and data center solutions as enterprises globally increase investments in AI and machine learning workloads and digital transformation, supported by more than US$130b of AI server orders in the past 12 months, a US$95b AI backlog and a pipeline that is multiples of backlog, which ties directly to future revenue and earnings.
Still, Dell Technologies faces real pressure points if AI server margins remain in the mid single digits or if tight component supply slows the conversion of its large backlog.

localization.title: Dell Technologies(DELL)는 AI 공장 업데이트로 인해 46% 저평가될 수 있음
summaryLines: Dell Technologies는 마지막으로 $322.79로 마감했으며 Simply Wall St의 분석가 합의 Narrative는 공정 가치를 $594.16으로 추정함

Dell Technologies는 지난 12개월 동안 미화 1,300억 달러 이상의 AI 서버 주문, 미화 950억 달러의 AI 백로그 및 향후 수익 및 수익과 직접적으로 연결되는 파이프라인의 지원을 받아 기업이 전 세계적으로 AI 및 머신 러닝 워크로드와 디지털 변혁에 대한 투자를 늘리면서 AI 서버 및 데이터 센터 솔루션에 대한 수요가 가속화되고 있음을 경험하고 있음
그럼에도 불구하고, Dell Technologies는 AI 서버 마진이 한 자릿수 중반에 머물거나 빠듯한 구성 요소 공급으로 인해 대규모 백로그의 전환이 느려지는 경우 실제 압력 포인트에 직면함

articles.title: Mistral plays catch-up with Vibe Desktop as rivals already command full operating systems
articles.descEn: Mistral's AI agent Vibe now has its own desktop app.
articles.titleEn: Mistral plays catch-up with Vibe Desktop as rivals already command full operating systems
summaryLinesEn: The agent can work either in a local repository or in a cloud sandbox, and the app uses Git worktrees to keep parallel tasks in the same project separate.

Mistral caught up on the model side in October with Large 4 , but in head-to-head comparisons it still trails Gemini 4 Carbon and Claude Opus 5.5 by a wide margin and also falls behind the strongest open models from China.
Mistral's AI agent Vibe now has its own desktop app.

The agent can work either in a local repository or in a cloud sandbox, and the app uses Git worktrees to keep parallel tasks in the same project separate.
Mistral caught up on the model side in October with Large 4 , but in head-to-head comparisons it still trails Gemini 4 Carbon and Claude Opus 5.5 by a wide margin and also falls behind the strongest open models from China.

summaryLines: Copilot이 디지털 동료가 되면서 Microsoft는 약 3.6% 상승 GuruFocus.com • 1개월 전 MSFT AI 지출 조사가 증가함에 따라 Microsoft는 Copilot을 개편 GuruFocus.com • 1개월 전 MSFT Microsoft는 매우 중요한 Microsoft 365 생산성 제품군에 더 많은 AI를 도입 Yahoo Finance • 11개월 전 MSFT NVDA Microsoft의 회계 분기 4차 AI 성장 전망 강화, BofA, PREMIUM MT Newswires 발표 • 2개월 전 MSFT Microsoft Corporation(MSFT)은 AI가 더 많은 일을 하길 원함

summaryLinesEn: The GIGABYTE B685-D80-LS1 is built for AMD EPYC 9006 Server CPUs, delivering up to 5,120 CPU cores in a single server.
With the rise of hyperscalers and AI cloud providers, the data center has shifted focus to massive rack-scale deployments.

articles.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
articles.descEn: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.
articles.titleEn: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
summaryLinesEn: This represents roughly a year of progress achieved in less than 5 months–unprecedented results at the frontier of chip design.
We took the geometric mean across those workloads and multiplied it by the maximum clock frequency estimated with Yosys.
Across the broader Jalapeño design effort, the team estimates that model proposed changes reduced standard-cell area by about 13% in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit.
articles.summary:
This represents roughly a year of progress achieved in less than 5 months–unprecedented results at the frontier of chip design.
We took the geometric mean across those workloads and multiplied it by the maximum clock frequency estimated with Yosys.
Across the broader Jalapeño design effort, the team estimates that model proposed changes reduced standard-cell area by about 13% in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit.

articles.titleEn: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
summaryLinesEn: On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.

It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.

articles.titleEn: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
summaryLinesEn: To try it, install Transformers from that PR: Then, moving from OLMoE to the real target, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: That repo holds the output of the project's conversion script : the dense weights, the experts quantized to 3 bits, and the n-gram table.

articles.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
articles.descEn: AlphaGenome 2 is our next-generation DNA sequence model that bridges single-cell biology and human genetics, predicting how variants affect human cell types.
articles.titleEn: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
summaryLinesEn: We trained AlphaGenome 2 on both bulk and single-cell data from human and mouse samples, including over 107 million individual cell profiles.
We expanded its reach with AlphaGenome Atlas , a platform containing predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome.

AlphaGenome 2 extends enhancer-gene mapping to primary human cell types — such as brain astrocytes, which support and protect neurons — helping researchers connect regulatory variants to their target genes in the specific cells where disease unfolds.

articles.title: Uber uses OpenAI to help people earn smarter and book faster
articles.descEn: Uber uses OpenAI to power AI assistants and voice features that help drivers earn smarter and riders book faster across a global real-time marketplace.
articles.titleEn: Uber uses OpenAI to help people earn smarter and book faster
summaryLinesEn: Uber operates at massive scale: 40 million trips per day, 10 million drivers and couriers across 15,000 cities in over 70 countries.

While Uber Assistant was initially expected to help newer drivers most, experienced drivers also returned repeatedly to ask follow-up questions and optimize their time on the platform—validating the product as a long-term utility, not just an onboarding tool.

Uber found that using AI to summarize and easily communicate Uber’s real-world data can accelerate ramp-up by helping drivers learn workflows and marketplace dynamics much faster than through trial and error alone.

articles.title: How Omio is building the future of conversational travel
articles.descEn: Discover how Omio uses OpenAI to power conversational travel experiences, accelerate product development, and transform into an AI-native company.
articles.titleEn: How Omio is building the future of conversational travel
summaryLinesEn: We sat down with Tomas Vocetka, Omio’s CTO, to discuss the company’s vision for conversational travel, its journey toward becoming AI-native, and how OpenAI is helping accelerate innovation across both customer experiences and internal operations.
As consumer expectations shift toward conversational interfaces, Omio saw an opportunity to rethink how travel discovery works.
Traditional travel planning often requires navigating multiple websites, comparing transportation modes, and piecing together itineraries across providers.

articles.title: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
articles.descEn: How Deutsche Telekom is becoming an AI-native telco with OpenAI-transforming customer service, employee workflows, network operations, and the future of voice.
articles.titleEn: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
summaryLinesEn: Reimagining employee workflows, customer service, and network operations, for an AI-native future Deutsche Telekom ⁠ (opens in a new window) is one of the world's largest telecommunications companies, serving more than 300 million customers across Europe and the United States and employing more than 200,000 people across the group.
As generative AI capabilities accelerated, Deutsche Telekom saw an opportunity that went beyond productivity gains.

We sat down with Jonathan Abrahamson, Chief Product & Digital Officer at Deutsche Telekom, to discuss how the company is redesigning the operating model of the entire organization-from customer care and employee workflows to network operations and the future of voice communications.

localization.title: Deutsche Telekom이 AI를 통해 통신을 재배선하는 방법
summaryLines: AI 기반 미래를 위해 직원 워크플로우, 고객 서비스, 네트워크 운영 재구상 Deutsche Telekom ⁠(새 창에서 열림)은 유럽과 미국 전역에서 3억 명 이상의 고객에게 서비스를 제공하고 그룹 전체에서 20만 명 이상의 직원을 고용하고 있는 세계 최대의 통신 회사 중 하나임
생성 AI 기능이 가속화되면서 Deutsche Telekom은 생산성 향상 이상의 기회를 발견함
우리는 Deutsche Telekom의 최고 제품 및 디지털 책임자인 Jonathan Abrahamson과 함께 회사가 고객 관리 및 직원 워크플로부터 네트워크 운영 및 음성 통신의 미래에 이르기까지 전체 조직의 운영 모델을 어떻게 재설계하고 있는지 논의함

With more than 120,000 people in 18 countries, Mercado Livre is the largest e-commerce platform in Latin America, transforming the way people buy, sell, and advertise across the region.

articles.title: How we raised Databricks cluster rate limits by 7.5× | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Learn how adaptive concurrency limits helped Databricks raise cluster-creation request-rate limits by 7.5× while protecting long-running workflows.
articles.titleEn: How we raised Databricks cluster rate limits by 7.5× | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Conservative limits turned away customer requests despite spare capacity, yet kept accepting requests when our services or dependencies, such as cloud providers, slowed down.
Engineers manually lowered limits to shed load during incidents and raised them again after recovery.

In this post, we'll explore why fixed request-rate limits can fall short for these long-running operations, how adaptive concurrency limits help, and what we learned applying them to cluster creation for Databricks classic compute.

articles.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
articles.descEn: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.
articles.titleEn: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment

articles.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
articles.descEn: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.
articles.titleEn: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
summaryLinesEn: From late August to early September 2026, we conducted a survey of 101 research staff to understand AI uplift, centered around the following hypothetical: “Suppose your team’s access to all coding agents better than GPT-5.2 was revoked for the next 3 months.
Today, we’re providing an update on the state of research acceleration at OpenAI, based on internal measurements of how coding agents have accelerated and changed the AI development cycle.

Notably, using this methodology, we find that Safety & Alignment saw the largest absolute increase across any research area, almost doubling in documented workweek contributions since the start of the year due to a combination of new hires and existing researchers shifting their focus toward safety projects.

summaryLines: AI 향상을 이해하기 위해 2026년 8월 말부터 9월 초까지 우리는 다음과 같은 가설을 중심으로 101명의 연구 직원을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시함 · “GPT-5.2보다 나은 모든 코딩 에이전트에 대한 팀의 액세스 권한이 향후 3개월 동안 취소되었다고 가정해 보겠음
오늘 우리는 코딩 에이전트가 AI 개발 주기를 어떻게 가속화하고 변경했는지에 대한 내부 측정을 기반으로 OpenAI의 연구 가속화 상태에 대한 업데이트를 제공하고 있음
특히, 이 방법론을 사용하면 안전 및 정렬이 모든 연구 영역에서 가장 큰 절대 증가를 보였으며, 신규 채용과 기존 연구원이 안전 프로젝트에 초점을 맞추면서 연초 이후 기록된 주당 근무 기여도가 거의 두 배로 증가한 것으로 나타남

articles.title: Inside the Codex sandbox
articles.descEn: See how Codex runs commands on your machine while enforcing the filesystem and network limits you control across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
articles.titleEn: Inside the Codex sandbox
summaryLinesEn: If the permission profile allows limited network access, the caller must supply a network proxy to enforce those limits: This function starts the process in a sandbox and returns a Child handle the harness can use to wait for it to finish.

Because one of the most common (and potentially risky) things Codex does is run commands on your computer, we built the Codex sandbox so Codex can work in your existing environment within filesystem and network limits you control.

The harness supplies the permission profile and, when needed, the network proxy: The exec_command tool also lets the model request different permissions for an individual command, but the harness decides whether to grant the request : When use_default is specified, the harness uses the default sandbox config for the turn. with_additional_permissions requests expanded access within the sandbox, while require_escalated requests execution outside it.

localization.title: Codex 샌드박스 내부
summaryLines: 권한 프로필이 제한된 네트워크 액세스를 허용하는 경우 호출자는 이러한 제한을 적용하기 위해 네트워크 프록시를 제공해야 함 · 이 함수는 샌드박스에서 프로세스를 시작하고 하네스가 완료될 때까지 기다리는 데 사용할 수 있는 하위 핸들을 반환함
Codex가 수행하는 가장 일반적이고 잠재적으로 위험한 작업 중 하나는 컴퓨터에서 명령을 실행하는 것이므로 Codex가 사용자가 제어하는 파일 시스템 및 네트워크 제한 내에서 기존 환경에서 작동할 수 있도록 Codex 샌드박스를 구축함

하네스는 권한 프로필을 제공하고 필요한 경우 네트워크 프록시를 제공함 · exec_command 도구를 사용하면 모델이 개별 명령에 대해 다른 권한을 요청할 수도 있지만 하네스는 요청 승인 여부를 결정함 · use_default가 지정되면 하네스는 해당 차례에 기본 샌드박스 구성을 사용함 · with_additional_permissions는 샌드박스 내에서 확장된 액세스를 요청하고, require_escalated는 샌드박스 외부에서 실행을 요청함

articles.title: The Silent Consensus
articles.descEn: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.
articles.titleEn: The Silent Consensus
summaryLinesEn: Software vulnerability discovery is the dual-use capability AI systems have arrived at today, but soon enough there will be another, and it will inspire its own urgent project to use the good side of the capability before malicious actors use the bad side.
We can become a new kind of man—not a transhuman, but a man expanded.

But these questions matter, because without a sense of what long-term futures we’d like to achieve–and which we’d like to avoid–we might end up with a macro outcome we disfavor, even if we made wise decisions at every step along the way.

articles.title: Africa’s Digital Progress Accelerates, but 64% Usage Gap Shows Next Challenge for Policymakers
articles.descEn: GSMA Digital Africa Index 2026 finds seven more countries joining the continent’s leading group for digital development and enabling policy 18 November 2026, Cape Town: Africa is making measurable progress on digital development and enabling policy, but turning widespread mobile broadband coverage into meaningful digital participation remains a critical challenge, according to the GSMA’s flagship […]
articles.titleEn: Africa’s Digital Progress Accelerates, but 64% Usage Gap Shows Next Challenge for Policymakers
summaryLinesEn: Mobile broadband networks now cover 92% of Africa’s population, yet only 28% use mobile internet on their own devices, leaving a 64% usage gap.
While the usage gap is a global challenge, it is largest in Africa, making accelerating adoption across the region particularly urgent.
With 64% of the population living within coverage but not using mobile internet, closing the usage gap requires us to tackle the barriers that continue to keep people offline.

articles.title: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
articles.descEn: Discover how Singapore Airlines uses OpenAI models and API to enhance customer support, travel discovery, and employee productivity, doubling CSAT for its Kris chatbot.
articles.titleEn: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
summaryLinesEn: After moving Kris from a traditional dialog-flow system to an LLM-powered conversational experience using the OpenAI API, Singapore Airlines saw a 2x increase in customer satisfaction.
With the OpenAI API and models, Singapore Airlines improves customer support, travel discovery, and employee work, doubling CSAT for the Kris customer service chatbot.
Beyond customer-facing experiences, Singapore Airlines is also using OpenAI models in parts of the software development lifecycle to help teams plan, refine, test, and review work more efficiently.

articles.descEn: Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.
articles.titleEn: How to manage AI investments in the agentic era
summaryLinesEn: From GPT‑4 to GPT‑5.4, the price per million tokens fell 97%.
As teams move from chat to longer-running workflows, admins need clearer visibility into demand, spend, and risk.
Enterprise leaders need a plain view of AI usage: who is using it, which products or models they are using, how much capacity they are consuming, and what kind of work that usage supports.

articles.title: The Future of Religion in Sub-Saharan Africa
articles.descEn: By 2070, most of the world’s Christians are projected to live in this region. Overall population growth in sub-Saharan Africa will outpace that of all other regions.
articles.titleEn: The Future of Religion in Sub-Saharan Africa
summaryLinesEn: In 2070, most countries in the region − 30 out of 50, including all countries in the southern portion of sub-Saharan Africa − will have Christian majorities, down from 32 in 2020.

Because it has younger populations and higher fertility than other regions, sub-Saharan Africa will have the world’s highest rate of population growth between 2020 and 2070, according to our projections.
In 2020, there were about 700 million Christians in sub-Saharan Africa, which was 31% of all Christians in the world.

summaryLinesEn: If recent demographic trends continue, Israel will be home to 62% of the global Jewish population in 2070, up from 46% in 2020.

57 At the same time, because the global Jewish population is expected to grow at a slower pace than other religious groups analyzed in this study, Jews will make up a slightly smaller percentage of all the people in the world in 2070 (0.17%) than they did in 2020 (0.19%).
Because of these divergent trends in the U.S. and Israel, the share of the global Jewish population living in America is projected to shrink, from 39% in 2020 to 26% in 2070.

articles.title: The Future of the Global Muslim Population
articles.descEn: Between 2020 and 2070, the world’s Muslim population is expected to grow more than all other religious groups combined.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Muslim Population
summaryLinesEn: According to Pew Research Center’s projections, the global Muslim population will grow in number by 80% between 2020 and 2070, while the global non-Muslim population will increase by 11%.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

The Muslim population will grow by 9 million in the United States but will still account for a relatively small percentage of the country’s total population (4%). 54 countries and territories will have Muslim majorities, including 35 places where Muslims will make up at least 90% of the population.

articles.title: The Future of the Global Population of Other Religions
articles.descEn: Followers of other religions are projected to grow more geographically dispersed in the coming decades
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Population of Other Religions
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, 29% of the global population of other religions is projected to live in sub-Saharan Africa by the end of the projection period, up from 16% in 2020.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

This group is projected to make up a larger share of the North American population in 2070 (about 3.0%) than in 2020 (1.4%), but the region is expected to continue to have far more Christians and religiously unaffiliated people than followers of other religions.

articles.title: The Future of Religion in Europe
articles.descEn: A slim majority of Europeans are projected to be Christian in 2070, while the percentage who are Muslim will double to 13%.
articles.titleEn: The Future of Religion in Europe
summaryLinesEn: The study anticipates that Europe’s Christian population will decrease by more than a third in absolute numbers in coming decades, from 505 million in 2020 to 324 million in 2070.
Due to lower fertility rates and an older population than other regions, Europe is the only major region in the world that we project will have a smaller total population in 2070 than it did in 2020.

In Europe, Christians will decline by at least 5 percentage points as a share of the population in 30 countries, while the Muslim share of the population will rise by 5 points or more in 21 countries.

articles.title: Islam Will Soon Be the World’s Largest Religion, but Christianity Will Keep Growing Too
articles.descEn: Muslims will outnumber Christians by 2035, driven by higher fertility, but both groups are projected to keep growing in the decades ahead.
articles.titleEn: Islam Will Soon Be the World’s Largest Religion, but Christianity Will Keep Growing Too
summaryLinesEn: The United States had the world’s largest Christian population in 2020, and it is expected to witness the greatest decline in the number of Christians, dropping from 217 million in 2020 to 174 million in 2070.
Despite this shift, Muslim population growth will not slow the rise of the Christian population.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

articles.title: Two-Thirds of Americans Disapprove of Trump’s Handling of the Russia-Ukraine War
articles.descEn: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.
articles.titleEn: Two-Thirds of Americans Disapprove of Trump’s Handling of the Russia-Ukraine War
summaryLinesEn: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.

As has been the case for most of the last few years, about half of adults (49%) say the U.S. has a responsibility to help Ukraine defend itself from Russia. 34% of Republicans continue to say the U.S. has this responsibility.
The share of Americans saying Trump is favoring Russia too much (39%) is 6 percentage points higher than in August 2025.

articles.titleEn: Coding agents in the social sciences
summaryLinesEn: But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.
The human sciences are shifting: for the first time, core research tasks can be handed off to machines.
These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

articles.titleEn: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
summaryLinesEn: The main findings from the Economic Index’s first paper are: Today, usage is concentrated in software development and technical writing tasks.
Economics Apr 22, 2026 Announcing the Anthropic Economic Index Survey In the coming years, AI systems will have a major impact on the ways people work.

We’d therefore expect AI to be adopted selectively for different tasks across different occupations, and that analyzing tasks—in addition to jobs as a whole—would give us a fuller picture of how AI is being integrated into the economy.

articles.title: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
articles.descEn: The second update from the Anthropic Economic Index on how people are using AI.
articles.titleEn: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
summaryLinesEn: Today, we’re releasing our second research report from the Index, covering usage data on Claude.ai following the launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet —our newest and most capable model with strengths in agentic coding and a new “extended thinking” mode.

Last month, we launched the Anthropic Economic Index —a new initiative where we’re regularly releasing data and research aimed at understanding AI's effects on labor markets and the economy over time.

While this increase in coding usage was expected due to Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s improved scores on coding benchmarks, the increase in these other categories could reflect either ongoing diffusion of AI throughout the economy, novel applications of coding to those domains, or unexpected capability improvements in the model.

localization.title: 경제 지수 · Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 통찰력
summaryLines: 오늘 우리는 에이전트 코딩과 새로운 "확장 사고" 모드의 강점을 갖춘 최신이자 가장 유능한 모델인 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 출시 이후 Claude.ai의 사용 데이터를 다루는 Index의 두 번째 연구 보고서를 발표함
지난 달 우리는 시간이 지남에 따라 AI가 노동 시장과 경제에 미치는 영향을 이해하기 위한 데이터와 연구를 정기적으로 공개하는 새로운 이니셔티브인 인류 경제 지수(Anthropic Economic Index)를 시작함
코딩 사용량의 이러한 증가는 Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 코딩 벤치마크 점수 향상으로 인해 예상되었지만, 이러한 다른 범주의 증가는 경제 전반에 걸친 AI의 지속적인 확산, 해당 영역에 대한 새로운 코딩 적용 또는 모델의 예상치 못한 기능 향상을 반영할 수 있음

articles.title: How people use Claude for support and advice
articles.descEn: Only 2.9% of Claude conversations involve emotional support, advice, or companionship. We share research on affective use and how we're building safeguards.
articles.titleEn: How people use Claude for support and advice
summaryLinesEn: Takeaway: Affective conversations are a small but meaningful slice of Claude usage (2.9%), with most people primarily using AI for work tasks and content creation.
Takeaway: People tend to shift towards slightly more positive emotional expressions while talking to Claude.

Less than 10% of coaching or counseling conversations involve Claude resisting user requests, and when it does, it's typically for safety reasons (for example, refusing to provide dangerous weight loss advice or support self-harm).

articles.title: Challenges in evaluating AI systems
articles.descEn: Insights from the red teaming approaches we've used to test our AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Challenges in evaluating AI systems
summaryLinesEn: Alignment Jun 16, 2025 SHADE-Arena: Evaluating sabotage and monitoring in LLM agents Most conversations around the societal impacts of artificial intelligence (AI) come down to discussing some quality of an AI system, such as its truthfulness, fairness, potential for misuse, and so on.
To speed up BIG-bench would require re-writing it in order to play well with our infrastructure—a significant engineering effort.

We hope that this post is useful to people who are developing AI governance initiatives that rely on evaluations, as well as people who are launching or scaling up organizations focused on evaluating AI systems.

articles.title: What 81,000 people told us about AI economics
articles.descEn: Anthropic's recent survey of 81,000 Claude users provides a way to connect people’s economic concerns with what we’ve quantified in Claude traffic.
articles.titleEn: What 81,000 people told us about AI economics
summaryLinesEn: In order to inform the public about the economic changes we’re observing with AI, our Economic Index shares what work Claude is being asked to do, and in which jobs Claude is doing the largest share of tasks.
Our recent survey of 81,000 Claude users shows that people who work in roles that are more exposed to AI have more concerns about AI-driven job displacement.
In contrast, some users sped up tasks they were already doing, like the accountant who said, “I built a tool that helps me finish a financing task in 15 minutes that used to take 2 hours.”

localization.title: 81,000명의 사람들이 AI 경제학에 관해 우리에게 말한 것
summaryLines: 우리가 AI를 통해 관찰하고 있는 경제적 변화를 대중에게 알리기 위해 우리의 경제 지수는 Claude가 수행하도록 요청받은 작업과 Claude가 가장 많은 작업을 수행하는 작업을 공유함
81,000명의 Claude 사용자를 대상으로 한 최근 설문 조사에 따르면 AI에 더 많이 노출되는 역할에 종사하는 사람들은 AI로 인한 일자리 대체에 대해 더 많은 우려를 갖고 있는 것으로 나타남
반면에 일부 사용자는 "2시간이 걸리던 자금 조달 작업을 15분 만에 완료하는 데 도움이 되는 도구를 만들었습니다"라고 말하는 회계사와 같이 이미 하고 있던 작업의 속도를 높였음

articles.title: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
articles.descEn: A randomized trial with 52 developers found AI assistance lowered comprehension scores, except when used for explanations rather than delegation.
articles.titleEn: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
summaryLinesEn: In a randomized controlled trial, we examined 1) how quickly software developers picked up a new skill (in this case, a Python library) with and without AI assistance; and 2) whether using AI made them less likely to understand the code they’d just written.
Though preliminary, these results suggest important considerations as companies transition to a greater ratio of AI-written to human-written code.

Here, AI creates a potential tension: as coding grows more automated and speeds up work, humans will still need the skills to catch errors, guide output, and ultimately provide oversight for AI deployed in high-stakes environments.

localization.title: AI 지원이 코딩 기술 형성에 미치는 영향
summaryLines: 무작위 대조 시험에서 우리는 1) 소프트웨어 개발자가 AI 지원 유무에 관계없이 얼마나 빨리 새로운 기술(이 경우 Python 라이브러리)을 습득했는지; 2) AI를 사용하면 방금 작성한 코드를 이해할 가능성이 낮아졌는지 여부
비록 예비적이긴 하지만, 이러한 결과는 기업이 AI로 작성한 코드와 사람이 작성한 코드의 비율을 더 높이는 방식으로 전환함에 따라 중요한 고려 사항을 제시함
여기에서 AI는 잠재적인 긴장감을 조성함 · 코딩이 더욱 자동화되고 작업 속도가 빨라짐에 따라 인간에게는 여전히 오류를 포착하고 출력을 안내하며 궁극적으로 고위험 환경에 배포된 AI를 감독하는 기술이 필요함

articles.titleEn: ストラテジスト AI時代の万能選手
summaryLinesEn: Sierraのエージェント・ストラテジストが継続的に調整を繰り返したことで、解決率が約30%向上しました。
今やるべきことと後回しにすべきことを判断し、要件の無制限な拡大に歯止めをかけ、関係部署には常に進化し続ける非決定論的なソフトウェアに慣れてもらいます。
グローバルなハードウェアメーカー： 16以上の言語への展開が急務となるなか、Sierraのエージェント・ストラテジストがシリアル番号の認識や、文字起こし・発音の課題といったエッジケースを一つひとつ解決し、わずか2か月足らずで本番稼働を実現しました。

articles.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Dharma-AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
summaryLinesEn: So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total, and compared analytical estimates against learned predictors.
A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation.
The short version: the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h).

localization.title: 미세 조정 작업이 FLOP에서 말하는 것보다 오래 걸리는 이유
summaryLines: 그래서 우리는 NVIDIA H200 GPU 생산 풀에서 272개의 실제 지도형 미세 조정(SFT) 작업(총 약 7,382 GPU 시간)을 가져와 학습된 예측 변수와 분석 추정치를 비교함
발송 전에 사용 가능한 정보만 보는 CatBoost 회귀자는 R² = 0.98에 도달하며, 5겹 교차 검증에서 평균 절대 오류는 1.71h, 중앙값 오류는 0.51h임
짧은 버전 · 일반적인 FLOP 기반 추정치는 우리가 관찰한 내용을 거의 설명하지 않습니다(R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41h)

articles.title: How Stretto built an AI voice agent with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Stretto replaced its web-form lead capture with Tara, an AI voice agent built on Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that conducts bankruptcy intake interviews by phone and qualifies leads. See how Stretto, the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center, and CI&T designed the voice architecture, validated it for sensitive conversations, and moved it to production.
articles.titleEn: How Stretto built an AI voice agent with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: When a caller dials the Bankruptcy.com number, Tara picks up, introduces herself, and guides the caller through a structured conversation.

The team chose Amazon Nova 2 Sonic over the previous voice solution for three reasons: Cost: Stretto reports a 95 percent reduction in per-minute voice cost compared to its previous solution, based on Amazon Bedrock on-demand pricing in us-east-1 as of April 2026.

Stretto used Twilio for telephony because Tara’s intake is fully automated, with no human agents taking calls, and because Stretto wanted a direct integration with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that kept its existing AWS backend in place.
